# 4Partners Site API 2.0.0

> The API of a 4Partners partner site: catalog, content and settings of the site, orders of the partner paid from its deposit, and the path of a customer from sign-in to an order.

- **Requests.** Every operation is `POST /v2/<group>/<entity>/<action>` with a JSON body; an operation without parameters takes `{}`. Keys are `snake_case`, ids go in the body, an unknown key gives 422.
- **Authorization.** The site token in `X-Auth-Token` (issued in the partner account). Customer groups (`customer-account`, `customer-cart`, `customer-order`) take the customer token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token`, issued by `customer-auth` with the site token: it is valid for an hour, `customer-auth/refresh` renews it with the one-time refresh token (30 days), `customer-auth/sign-out` ends the sign-in. Customer tokens stop working after a password change or reset and when the site token that issued them is disabled. Dictionaries accept either token; other operations read only `X-Auth-Token`. A wrong kind of token gives 403 `customer-token-required` or `site-token-required`.
- **Responses.** A JSON envelope `{timestamp, error, data, meta}`; a field without a value is `null`. Money is a decimal string (`"65095.00"`), country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`RU`).
- **Errors.** `application/problem+json` with a stable `type` to branch on, `detail` and `pointer` to the wrong value.
- **Language.** The language of data (product names, characteristics, rubrics, countries, articles) is set by `site_variation` in the body: the code of a site variation from `settings/site-variation/list`, the default variation when omitted. `Accept-Language: en` or `ru` (English by default) sets only the language of error texts (`detail`).
- **Limits.** 600 requests per minute (sliding window) for each group, counted per site: all tokens of the site share one counter; in customer groups — per customer. The state is in `meta.usage` and `X-RateLimit-*` headers; over the limit — 429 with `Retry-After`.
- **For AI agents.** `/v2/llms.txt` — groups and operations one line each; `/v2/llms-full.txt` — every operation with its body fields, response fields and error types, in Markdown.

Base URL: `https://api.4partners.io/v2`. Every operation is `POST` with a JSON body (`Content-Type: application/json`); an operation without parameters takes `{}`.

## Docs

- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.4partners.io/v2.jsonopenapi): the machine-readable contract with schemas and examples
- [API reference](https://api.4partners.io/v2): the same contract for people
- [Error types](https://api.4partners.io/api/problems): what each `type` of an error means and how to fix it
- [Short index](https://api.4partners.io/v2/llms.txt): groups and operations, one line each

## Stock

Prices, stock, cards, search and facets of products sold on the site — for storefronts and sync.

### List search facets

`POST /v2/stock/facet/list` · `stock_facet_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Facets of the selection of `stock/product/search` with the same filters: aspect values with the number of products, brands with the number of products and the price range, by the search index. As in the storefront filters, the counts of an aspect do not take its own selected values into account, brands — `brand_ids`, the price range — `price_from` and `price_to`: a client shows how many products each other value would give. With `rubric_id` the aspects are the filters of the rubric in their order (`rubric/aspect/list`). A separate operation, not a part of `stock/product/search`: facets do not change from page to page, and each selected aspect costs one more query to the index.

Body:
- `query` (string or null, length ≤ 200): Search text: name, brand, article. Spaces at the edges are ignored; an empty text or only spaces — no text filter.
- `rubric_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Rubric of the site rubric tree (`rubric/list`), with its subrubrics; a rubric of another tree gives 422. With a rubric the facets are its filter aspects (`rubric/aspect/list`).
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 50, item 1..2147483647): Rubrics of the site rubric tree: products of any of them, with subrubrics; together with `rubric_id`. The filter aspects of a rubric apply only when one rubric is chosen.
- `brand_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item 1..2147483647): Brand ids: products of any of them.
- `param_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item ≥ 1): Aspect values (param ids): values of one aspect are combined with OR, different aspects with AND, as in `stock/product/search`. At most 10 different aspects: each selected aspect costs a separate count in the search index.
- `price_from` (number or null, ≥ 0): Minimum price by the search index, in the primary currency of the site.
- `price_to` (number or null, > 0): Maximum price by the search index, in the primary currency of the site; not less than `price_from`.
- `in_stock` (boolean, default true): Only products in stock by the search index. The index lags behind live data: a product sold out after the last indexing still comes, with `available: false` — the storefront hides such a product itself, pages stay full and `meta.pager.total` stays honest. False — also products without stock, but only if the site shows them (`shows_out_of_stock_products` of `settings/info/show`); otherwise the same products as true.
- `discount_only` (boolean, default false): Only discounted products.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the names and the delivery country; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

Response 200, `data`:
- `aspects` (array of object): Aspects of the selection with their values: the filter aspects of `rubric_id`; without a rubric — the default filter aspects of the storefront; with `query` — any aspects of the found products. Up to 50 aspects, most used first.
- `aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name in the language of the variation.
- `aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id (`aspect/group/list`), as in `aspect/batch-show`: a filter panel can group the aspects without more requests.
- `aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name in the language of the variation.
- `aspects[].values` (array of object): Values with the number of products, up to 200, in the order of the storefront filter: sizes from small to large (`XS`, `S`, `M` …, numbers ascending; a size the storefront does not know goes last), other aspects — most products first; selected values (`param_ids`) are always here, with 0 when nothing has them. Counts take every filter into account except the values of this aspect.
- `aspects[].values[].id` (integer): Param id: pass it in `param_ids` of `stock/product/search`.
- `aspects[].values[].name` (string): Value in the language of the variation.
- `aspects[].values[].count` (integer): Number of products of the selection with this value, by the search index.
- `aspects[].values[].selected` (boolean): The value is in `param_ids` of the request.
- `aspects[].values[].color_hex_code` (string or null): Colour of the value as `#RRGGBB` for a colour swatch, as in `aspect/param/batch-show`; `null` — no colour is set.
- `brands` (array of object): Brands of the selection, up to 100, most products first; the counts do not take `brand_ids` into account.
- `brands[].id` (integer): Brand id: pass it in `brand_ids` of `stock/product/search`.
- `brands[].name` (string): Brand name.
- `brands[].count` (integer): Number of products of the selection of this brand, by the search index.
- `brands[].selected` (boolean): The brand is in `brand_ids` of the request.
- `price` (object): Price range of the selection without `price_from` and `price_to`; `null` — nothing is found.
- `price.min` (string): Lowest price, decimal string: a value for `price_from`.
- `price.max` (string): Highest price, decimal string: a value for `price_to`.
- `price.currency` (string): ISO 4217 code of the primary currency of the site: the currency of the search index prices, of `price_from` and `price_to`; live prices of `stock/product/search` are in the currency of the variation.
- `rubrics` (array of object): Main rubrics of the products of the selection, up to 100, most products first — the categories of a brand page or a search; the counts do not take `rubric_id` and `rubric_ids` into account.
- `rubrics[].id` (integer): Rubric id: pass it in `rubric_ids` of `stock/product/search`.
- `rubrics[].name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation`.
- `rubrics[].count` (integer): Number of products of the selection with this main rubric, by the search index.
- `rubrics[].selected` (boolean): The rubric is in `rubric_id` or `rubric_ids` of the request.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List prices and stock

`POST /v2/stock/list` · `stock_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Current prices and stock of up to 100 products (`product_ids`, all variations) or 500 variations (`product_variation_ids`) — a light answer for frequent polling instead of `stock/product/batch-show`. The same variations, prices, stock and `unavailable_reason` as `variations` of `stock/product/show` for the same `site_variation` and `country`: a product closed for the site is left out, and so is a requested variation that the card does not show. The answer keeps the order of the request: products of `product_ids` first, then the products of `product_variation_ids` in the order of their first variation; variations of a whole product — in the order of the card, requested variations — in the order of the request; a repeated id is returned once. Prices are decimal strings with 2 digits after the point, `null` without an offer; `old_price` — only when above `price`, as in the card. `with_partner_price` adds `partner_price` — the purchase price of the partner at 4Partners.

Body:
- `product_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item 1..2147483647): Product ids, up to 100: all variations of the products, in the order of the request. Pass `product_ids`, `product_variation_ids` or both.
- `product_variation_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 500, item 1..2147483647): Product variation ids, up to 500: only these variations, in the order of the request after the products of `product_ids`. A variation that is not in `variations` of `stock/product/show` (no images, no offers at all) is left out.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): country and currency of prices and stock; `null` or omitted — the default variation.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`dictionary/country/list`): prices and stock for this country in its primary currency on the site; `null` or omitted — the country of the variation.
- `with_partner_price` (boolean, default false): Add `partner_price`: the purchase price of the partner at 4Partners.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `product_id` (integer): Product id.
- `currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of the prices.
- `variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site — the same set as `variations` of `stock/product/show` (or the requested ones of them), each with its price and stock.
- `variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id.
- `variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — no active offer of the site for the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The same as `price` of the variation in `stock/product/show`.
- `variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`). The same as `old_price` of the variation in `stock/product/show`.
- `variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true; the values of `unavailable_reason` in `stock/product/show`.
- `variations[].partner_price` (string or null): Purchase price of the partner at 4Partners in `currency`, decimal string with 2 digits after the point; `null` without `with_partner_price` or without an offer.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List products by ids

`POST /v2/stock/product/batch-show` · `stock_product_batch_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Up to 100 products in the order of `product_ids`, in the format of `stock/product/show`; a repeated id is returned once, an id that is not a positive integer gives 422. Products not in the site tree and unknown ids are left out, products closed for the site come with `closed: true` and no `variations`: take such products off sale.

Body:
- `product_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..100, item 1..2147483647): Product ids, 1 to 100; a repeated id is returned once.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices and stock, language of names and the storefront of `url`; `null` or omitted — the default variation.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`dictionary/country/list`): prices and stock for this country in its primary currency on the site; `null` or omitted — the country of the variation.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Product id.
- `name` (string): Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.
- `description` (string): Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.
- `locale` (string or null): Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).
- `slug` (string): Slug of the product page on the site.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.
- `brand_id` (integer or null): Brand id.
- `brand` (string or null): Brand name.
- `primary_rubric_id` (integer or null): Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).
- `available` (boolean): At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).
- `closed` (boolean): The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.
- `min_price` (string or null): Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.
- `currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.
- `image` (string or null): Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.
- `external_id` (string or null): Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.
- `variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).
- `variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.
- `variations[].description` (string): Variation description, the source text.
- `variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.
- `variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).
- `variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.
- `variations[].images` (array of string): Image URLs, the first is the main one.
- `variations[].param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.
- `variations[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.
- `variations[].warehouse_country` (string or null): Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.
- `variations[].vendor_id` (integer or null): Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.
- `variations[].external_sku` (string or null): SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `aspects` (array of object): Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.
- `aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name.
- `aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id.
- `aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name.
- `aspects[].role` (string: `variant` | `property`): `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.
- `params` (array of object): Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.
- `params[].id` (integer): Param id.
- `params[].name` (string): Param value.
- `params[].aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List product ids of the site

`POST /v2/stock/product/id/list` · `stock_product_id_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

All product ids of the site rubric tree, or of `rubric_id` with its subrubrics, in ascending order, page by page: pass `next_cursor` of the answer as `cursor` until it is null. Read from the database, not from the search index, so a product does not drop out of the list while it is being reindexed. Availability is not checked here: use `stock/product/batch-show`. With `store_id` — products of the tree of a source store (`source/store/list`, rubrics — `source/store-rubric/list`) instead of the site tree: candidates to add to the site with `product/rubric/link`; a site that is not a source store gives 404, a `rubric_id` of another tree — 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only products of this rubric and its subrubrics: of the site tree, or of the source store tree with `store_id`.
- `cursor` (string or null, pattern `^\d+$`): Opaque cursor: omit for the first page, then pass `next_cursor` of the previous page.
- `limit` (integer, 1..10000, default 1000): Page size.
- `store_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Source store id from `source/store/list`: products of its tree instead of the site tree (with `rubric_id` — of a rubric from `source/store-rubric/list`). They are not products of the site until linked with `product/rubric/link`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `ids` (array of integer): Product ids in ascending order.
- `next_cursor` (string or null): Opaque cursor of the next page for `cursor`; null — this page is the last one.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Search products

`POST /v2/stock/product/search` · `stock_product_search` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Products of the site found in the search index by text, rubric, brands, aspect values (`param_ids`: OR inside one aspect, AND between aspects), price, stock and discount, page by page (`meta.pager`), in the format of `stock/product/show`: prices and stock are current, not from the index. Every page is exactly the window of the index: a product the index has in stock but the live data does not comes with `available: false` instead of dropping out, so pages are full and their sum is `meta.pager.total`. A product closed for the site after the last indexing comes with `closed: true`; only a product unlinked from the site tree after the last indexing is left out, until the next indexing. The storefront hides a product with `available: false` itself; a product without `variations` cannot be sold now. With `sort` by price, products without a current price (`min_price: null`) go last on each page. A product added since the last indexing is not found yet: `stock/product/id/list` reads the database. Facets of the same selection (values with counts, brands, price range) — `stock/facet/list`. Pages go down to 10 000 products: to get all products use `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/batch-show`.

Body:
- `query` (string or null, length ≤ 200): Search text: name, brand, article. Spaces at the edges are ignored; an empty text or only spaces — no text filter.
- `rubric_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Rubric of the site rubric tree (`rubric/list`), with its subrubrics; a rubric of another tree gives 422.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 50, item 1..2147483647): Rubrics of the site rubric tree: products of any of them, with subrubrics; together with `rubric_id`. The filter aspects of a rubric apply only when one rubric is chosen.
- `brand_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item 1..2147483647): Brand ids: products of any of them.
- `param_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item ≥ 1): Aspect values (param ids from `stock/facet/list`): values of one aspect are combined with OR, different aspects with AND — `[red, blue, XL]` finds red or blue products of size XL. With `rubric_id`, only values of the filter aspects of the rubric (`rubric/aspect/list`) are accepted, if the rubric has them.
- `price_from` (number or null, ≥ 0): Minimum price by the search index, in the primary currency of the site (`price` of `stock/facet/list`).
- `price_to` (number or null, > 0): Maximum price by the search index, in the primary currency of the site; not less than `price_from`.
- `in_stock` (boolean, default true): Only products in stock by the search index. The index lags behind live data: a product sold out after the last indexing still comes, with `available: false` — the storefront hides such a product itself, pages stay full and `meta.pager.total` stays honest. False — also products without stock, but only if the site shows them (`shows_out_of_stock_products` of `settings/info/show`); otherwise the same products as true.
- `discount_only` (boolean, default false): Only discounted products.
- `sort` (string: `relevance` | `popular` | `price_asc` | `price_desc` | `discount` | `new`, default `relevance`): Order of the results.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices and stock; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: prices and stock for this country in its primary currency on the site.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1; `page` × `per_page` is at most 10 000.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 20): Page size, 1 to 100, 20 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Product id.
- `name` (string): Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.
- `description` (string): Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.
- `locale` (string or null): Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).
- `slug` (string): Slug of the product page on the site.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.
- `brand_id` (integer or null): Brand id.
- `brand` (string or null): Brand name.
- `primary_rubric_id` (integer or null): Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).
- `available` (boolean): At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).
- `closed` (boolean): The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.
- `min_price` (string or null): Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.
- `currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.
- `image` (string or null): Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.
- `external_id` (string or null): Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.
- `variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).
- `variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.
- `variations[].description` (string): Variation description, the source text.
- `variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.
- `variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).
- `variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.
- `variations[].images` (array of string): Image URLs, the first is the main one.
- `variations[].param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.
- `variations[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.
- `variations[].warehouse_country` (string or null): Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.
- `variations[].vendor_id` (integer or null): Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.
- `variations[].external_sku` (string or null): SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `aspects` (array of object): Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.
- `aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name.
- `aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id.
- `aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name.
- `aspects[].role` (string: `variant` | `property`): `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.
- `params` (array of object): Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.
- `params[].id` (integer): Param id.
- `params[].name` (string): Param value.
- `params[].aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show a product

`POST /v2/stock/product/show` · `stock_product_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

A product card of the site: name and description in the language of `site_variation` when translated (`locale`), `url` of the page on the site, main `image`, `min_price`, aspects with their `role` and variations. The price of a variation comes from the best active offer of the site for the country at the time of the request — the same offer `order/create` takes — and is the same as in `stock/list`. A product without `variations` (no variation has images and an offer) cannot be sold now: `available: false`, `min_price: null`. A variation that cannot be ordered has `available: false`, stock 0 and `unavailable_reason`; its price stays when there is an offer (`out_of_stock`, `price_over_limit`, `weight_over_limit`) and is `null` without one (`no_offer`). What is the same for all variations (`currency`, `url`, shared properties) is given once on the product. Money is a decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`), country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case. A product of the site tree closed for the site (country, brand or rubric restrictions, a manual denial) comes with `closed: true` and no `variations`; a product not in the site tree gives 404.

Body:
- `product_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Product id; or pass `url` instead.
- `url` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Storefront address or slug of the product instead of `product_id` (an app deep link): `https://shop.example/product/nike-air-a123#v456`, `/product/nike-air-a123` or `nike-air-a123` — the product id is the number after `-a` at the end of the path, any case.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices and stock, language of names and the storefront of `url`; `null` or omitted — the default variation.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`dictionary/country/list`): prices and stock for this country in its primary currency on the site; `null` or omitted — the country of the variation.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Product id.
- `name` (string): Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.
- `description` (string): Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.
- `locale` (string or null): Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).
- `slug` (string): Slug of the product page on the site.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.
- `brand_id` (integer or null): Brand id.
- `brand` (string or null): Brand name.
- `primary_rubric_id` (integer or null): Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).
- `available` (boolean): At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).
- `closed` (boolean): The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.
- `min_price` (string or null): Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.
- `currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.
- `image` (string or null): Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.
- `external_id` (string or null): Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.
- `variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).
- `variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.
- `variations[].description` (string): Variation description, the source text.
- `variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.
- `variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).
- `variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.
- `variations[].images` (array of string): Image URLs, the first is the main one.
- `variations[].param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.
- `variations[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.
- `variations[].warehouse_country` (string or null): Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.
- `variations[].vendor_id` (integer or null): Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.
- `variations[].external_sku` (string or null): SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `aspects` (array of object): Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.
- `aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name.
- `aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id.
- `aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name.
- `aspects[].role` (string: `variant` | `property`): `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.
- `params` (array of object): Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.
- `params[].id` (integer): Param id.
- `params[].name` (string): Param value.
- `params[].aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show similar products

`POST /v2/stock/product/similar` · `stock_product_similar` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

The «you may also like» block of a product card, as on the storefront: up to 12 products of the same main rubric in stock, in a random order that changes every few hours, and `brand_rubric` — the brand of the product in its rubric for a «more of this brand» link (`stock/product/search` with `rubric_ids` and `brand_ids`). A product not in the site tree gives 404.

Body:
- `product_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product id of the card.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices and stock; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: prices and stock for this country.

Response 200, `data`:
- `products` (array of object): Up to 12 products of the same main rubric in stock, in a random order that changes every few hours, in the format of `stock/product/show`; the product itself is not among them.
- `products[].id` (integer): Product id.
- `products[].name` (string): Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.
- `products[].description` (string): Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.
- `products[].locale` (string or null): Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).
- `products[].slug` (string): Slug of the product page on the site.
- `products[].url` (string): Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.
- `products[].brand_id` (integer or null): Brand id.
- `products[].brand` (string or null): Brand name.
- `products[].primary_rubric_id` (integer or null): Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.
- `products[].rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).
- `products[].available` (boolean): At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).
- `products[].closed` (boolean): The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.
- `products[].min_price` (string or null): Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.
- `products[].currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.
- `products[].image` (string or null): Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.
- `products[].external_id` (string or null): Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `products[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.
- `products[].variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).
- `products[].variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.
- `products[].variations[].description` (string): Variation description, the source text.
- `products[].variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.
- `products[].variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).
- `products[].variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `products[].variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `products[].variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.
- `products[].variations[].images` (array of string): Image URLs, the first is the main one.
- `products[].variations[].param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.
- `products[].variations[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.
- `products[].variations[].warehouse_country` (string or null): Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.
- `products[].variations[].vendor_id` (integer or null): Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.
- `products[].variations[].external_sku` (string or null): SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `products[].aspects` (array of object): Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.
- `products[].aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `products[].aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name.
- `products[].aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `products[].aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id.
- `products[].aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name.
- `products[].aspects[].role` (string: `variant` | `property`): `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.
- `products[].params` (array of object): Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.
- `products[].params[].id` (integer): Param id.
- `products[].params[].name` (string): Param value.
- `products[].params[].aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.
- `brand_rubric` (object): The brand of the product in its main rubric, for a «more of this brand» link; `null` — the product has no brand or main rubric.
- `brand_rubric.rubric_id` (integer): Main rubric of the product: pass it with `brand_id` to `stock/product/search` (`rubric_ids`, `brand_ids`) or `rubric/brand/show`.
- `brand_rubric.rubric_name` (string): Rubric name in the language of `site_variation`.
- `brand_rubric.brand_id` (integer): Brand of the product.
- `brand_rubric.brand_name` (string): Brand name.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Suggest products while typing

`POST /v2/stock/product/suggest` · `stock_product_suggest` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Up to `limit` products for the search box while the customer types, by the same search as the storefront drop-down (name, brand, article; the search method of the site), in the format of `stock/product/show`. For the full result use `stock/product/search` with the same text. Fewer than 2 characters give 422.

Body:
- `query` (string, required, length 2..200): Text being typed, at least 2 characters.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the search and of names, prices and stock; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: prices and stock for this country.
- `limit` (integer, 1..10, default 5): How many products, 1 to 10.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Product id.
- `name` (string): Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.
- `description` (string): Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.
- `locale` (string or null): Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).
- `slug` (string): Slug of the product page on the site.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.
- `brand_id` (integer or null): Brand id.
- `brand` (string or null): Brand name.
- `primary_rubric_id` (integer or null): Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).
- `available` (boolean): At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).
- `closed` (boolean): The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.
- `min_price` (string or null): Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.
- `currency` (string): ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.
- `image` (string or null): Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.
- `external_id` (string or null): Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.
- `variations` (array of object): Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).
- `variations[].id` (integer): Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.
- `variations[].description` (string): Variation description, the source text.
- `variations[].price` (string or null): Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.
- `variations[].old_price` (string or null): Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).
- `variations[].quantity` (integer): Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.
- `variations[].available` (boolean): Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.
- `variations[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_offer` | `out_of_stock` | `price_over_limit` | `weight_over_limit` or null): Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.
- `variations[].images` (array of string): Image URLs, the first is the main one.
- `variations[].param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.
- `variations[].property_param_ids` (array of integer): Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.
- `variations[].warehouse_country` (string or null): Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.
- `variations[].vendor_id` (integer or null): Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.
- `variations[].external_sku` (string or null): SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.
- `aspects` (array of object): Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.
- `aspects[].id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `aspects[].name` (string): Aspect name.
- `aspects[].type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.
- `aspects[].aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id.
- `aspects[].aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name.
- `aspects[].role` (string: `variant` | `property`): `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.
- `params` (array of object): Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.
- `params[].id` (integer): Param id.
- `params[].name` (string): Param value.
- `params[].aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Product

Manage products of the site: texts and SEO, translations, placement in rubrics.

### Set the main rubric of products

`POST /v2/product/primary-rubric/update` · `product_primary_rubric_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Makes an active rubric of the site tree the main rubric (breadcrumbs, «all products of the category», `item_category`) of up to 1000 products linked to it: the flag is removed from their other rubrics of the site. The main rubric changes at once; restrictions and the search index are updated in the background. Unlike `product/rubric/link`, the rubric must be active (422 `rubric-inactive`): the main rubric is shown on the storefront. Products not linked to the rubric are returned in `not_linked_product_ids` and not changed: link them with `product/rubric/link` first. Unknown product ids are returned in `rejected_product_ids`, as in `product/rubric/link`; a request without a single known product gives 422 `no-products-accepted`, a rubric not in the site tree — 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `product_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..1000, item ≤ 2147483647): Product ids, 1 to 1000; a repeated id is processed once, an unknown id is returned in `rejected_product_ids`.
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): An active rubric of the site tree (`rubric/list`) that becomes the main rubric of the products linked to it; an inactive one gives 422 `rubric-inactive`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `rubric_id` (integer): The rubric that became the main rubric.
- `updated_product_ids` (array of integer): Products linked to the rubric: it is now their main rubric (breadcrumbs, `item_category`, «all products of the category»).
- `not_linked_product_ids` (array of integer): Products not linked to the rubric: not changed. Link them with `product/rubric/link` first.
- `rejected_product_ids` (array of integer): Unknown product ids: skipped, as in `product/rubric/link`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/rubric-inactive`, `/api/problems/no-products-accepted`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Link products to rubrics

`POST /v2/product/rubric/link` · `product_rubric_link` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Accepts linking of up to 1000 products to rubrics of the site tree and to all their ancestors, so a product of a subrubric is shown in the parent rubrics too. Any product of the common catalog can be linked, not only one already on the site: this is how the partner builds the assortment of the site — a product linked to the site tree becomes a product of the site (find products to add in a source store: rubrics — `source/store-rubric/list`, their products — `stock/product/id/list` with `store_id` and `rubric_id`). An inactive rubric is accepted: a section can be filled before it is switched on (`rubric/activate`); `product/primary-rubric/update` needs an active one. 202: the links, the main rubric, restrictions and the search index are updated in the background within minutes; check with `stock/product/id/list` with `rubric_id`. `rubric_ids` of the answer — the rubrics the products are linked to: each requested rubric followed by its ancestors from the root. Unknown product ids are returned in `rejected_product_ids` and skipped; a rubric not in the site tree rejects the whole request (422 `rubric-not-in-tree`), as does a request without a single known product (422 `no-products-accepted`).

Body:
- `product_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..1000, item ≤ 2147483647): Product ids of the common catalog, 1 to 1000 — not only products of the site: a linked product becomes a product of the site. A repeated id is linked once, an unknown id is returned in `rejected_product_ids`.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..100, item ≤ 2147483647): Rubric ids of the site tree (`rubric/list`), 1 to 100: the products are linked to each of them and to all their ancestors.

Response 202, `data`:
- `product_ids` (array of integer): Products accepted for linking.
- `rejected_product_ids` (array of integer): Unknown product ids: not linked.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer): Rubrics the products are linked to: each requested rubric followed by its ancestors from the root.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/no-products-accepted`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Unlink products from rubrics

`POST /v2/product/rubric/unlink` · `product_rubric_unlink` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Accepts unlinking of up to 1000 products of the site from rubrics of the site tree together with their subrubrics. `with_ancestors` also removes the ancestors of each rubric (undoes `product/rubric/link`), but only those where the product has no other link left in the subtree: a product of a neighbouring section stays in the common parents. Without `rubric_ids` the products are unlinked from all rubrics of the site and leave the site. 202: done in the background within minutes, the main rubric and restrictions are recalculated from the new links. `rubric_ids` of the answer are the requested rubrics: which subrubrics and ancestors are removed is decided per product when the job runs, by its links at that moment. Products not in the site tree are returned in `rejected_product_ids`; a rubric not in the site tree rejects the whole request (422 `rubric-not-in-tree`), as does a request without a single product of the site (422 `no-products-accepted`).

Body:
- `product_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..1000, item ≤ 2147483647): Product ids of the site tree, 1 to 1000; a repeated id is unlinked once, a product not in the site tree is returned in `rejected_product_ids`.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer or null, items 1..100, item ≤ 2147483647): Rubric ids of the site tree (`rubric/list`), 1 to 100: the products are unlinked from each of them and from their subrubrics; `null` or omitted — from all rubrics of the site, the products leave the site.
- `with_ancestors` (boolean): Unlink also from the ancestors of each rubric — undoes `product/rubric/link`, which links to the ancestors too. An ancestor stays linked while the product has another link in its subtree (a neighbouring section). Ignored without `rubric_ids`.

Response 202, `data`:
- `product_ids` (array of integer): Products accepted for unlinking.
- `rejected_product_ids` (array of integer): Products not in the site tree: nothing to unlink.
- `rubric_ids` (array of integer or null): The requested rubrics, each unlinked together with its subrubrics (and with `with_ancestors` — the ancestors left without other links of the product in their subtree, decided per product when the job runs); null — all rubrics of the site.
- `with_ancestors` (boolean): Ancestors are unlinked too (where the product has no other link in their subtree); false without `rubric_ids`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/no-products-accepted`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show site texts of a product

`POST /v2/product/text/show` · `product_text_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Texts and SEO the site set over the common translation for a product of the site tree and its variations, in every language of the site variations (and in any other language the site has texts of the product in), in the format of the answers of `product/update` and `product/variation/update` — to compare them with a CMS before writing. A `null` field is not set by the site. With `site_variation` — only its language. `with_source` adds the texts the storefront shows where a site text is not set: `common` of each language (the common translation) and `source` (the catalog texts). A product not in the site tree gives 404.

Body:
- `product_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product id of the site tree (`stock/product/id/list`).
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): only the language of this variation; `null` or omitted — every language of the site variations and every language the site has texts of the product in.
- `with_source` (boolean, default false): Add the texts the storefront shows without site texts, to compare: `source` (catalog texts) and `common` of each language (common translation).

Response 200, `data`:
- `product_id` (integer): Product id.
- `source` (object): With `with_source`: name and description of the catalog, without translations and site texts — the storefront shows them where there is neither; `null` without `with_source`.
- `source.name` (string or null): Name; null — not set (no translation in this language).
- `source.description` (string or null): Description, HTML; null — not set (no translation in this language).
- `locales` (array of object): Texts by language: the languages of the site variations first (the default variation first), then other languages the site has texts of the product in; with `site_variation` — its language only.
- `locales[].locale` (string): Language of the texts.
- `locales[].site_variations` (array of string): Codes of the site variations in this language (`settings/site-variation/list`); empty — the site has texts in a language none of its variations uses now.
- `locales[].product` (object): Site texts of the product in this language, as `product/update` answers; a `null` field is not set by the site.
- `locales[].product.product_id` (integer): Product id.
- `locales[].product.locale` (string): Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).
- `locales[].product.name` (string or null): Name of the product on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the common translation or the original name.
- `locales[].product.description` (string or null): Description of the product on the site, HTML; null — not set by the site.
- `locales[].product.meta_title` (string or null): SEO title of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `locales[].product.meta_description` (string or null): SEO meta description of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `locales[].product.meta_keywords` (string or null): SEO meta keywords of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `locales[].product.meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots of the product page: `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW` or `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW`; null — not set by the site (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).
- `locales[].variations` (array of object): Site texts of the variations that have at least one in this language, by id, as `product/variation/update` answers; a variation not listed has none.
- `locales[].variations[].product_variation_id` (integer): Product variation id.
- `locales[].variations[].product_id` (integer): Product id of the variation.
- `locales[].variations[].locale` (string): Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).
- `locales[].variations[].name` (string or null): Name of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the name of the product on the site, the common translation or the original name.
- `locales[].variations[].description` (string or null): Description of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site.
- `locales[].common` (object): With `with_source`: the common translation of the product in this language — the storefront shows it where the site text is not set; a `null` field has no translation, the storefront shows `source`. `null` without `with_source`.
- `locales[].common.name` (string or null): Name; null — not set (no translation in this language).
- `locales[].common.description` (string or null): Description, HTML; null — not set (no translation in this language).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update texts of a product

`POST /v2/product/update` · `product_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Sets the name, description and SEO fields of a product of the site tree in the language of `site_variation`: the site texts take precedence over the common translation on the storefront and in `stock/product/show`. An omitted or `null` field stays as it is; an empty string (or only spaces) resets the field — the storefront shows the common translation or the original text again. Spaces around values are trimmed. `meta_robots` takes one of the four values the storefront understands. The description is HTML and is shown on the storefront as is, without sanitizing. Answers with all site texts of the product in this language; all languages — `product/text/show`. A product not in the site tree gives 404 (a product closed for the site can still get texts), no field at all — 422.

Body:
- `product_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product id of the site tree (`stock/product/id/list`).
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the texts are written in its language; `null` or omitted — the default variation.
- `name` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Name of the product on the site, plain text; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string (or only spaces) — reset to the common translation. Spaces around are trimmed in every text field.
- `description` (string or null, length ≤ 100000): Description of the product on the site, HTML; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset to the common translation. The storefront outputs the HTML as is, without sanitizing (scripts and styles included): pass only markup you trust.
- `meta_title` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): SEO title of the product page; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `meta_description` (string or null, length ≤ 4000): SEO meta description of the product page; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `meta_keywords` (string or null, length ≤ 4000): SEO meta keywords of the product page, comma-separated; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `meta_robots` (string or null, length ≤ 100): Meta robots of the product page: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).

Response 200, `data`:
- `product_id` (integer): Product id.
- `locale` (string): Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).
- `name` (string or null): Name of the product on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the common translation or the original name.
- `description` (string or null): Description of the product on the site, HTML; null — not set by the site.
- `meta_title` (string or null): SEO title of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `meta_description` (string or null): SEO meta description of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `meta_keywords` (string or null): SEO meta keywords of the product page; null — not set by the site.
- `meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots of the product page: `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW` or `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW`; null — not set by the site (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update texts of a product variation

`POST /v2/product/variation/update` · `product_variation_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Sets the name and description of a product variation in the language of `site_variation`, over the texts of the product. An omitted or `null` field stays as it is; an empty string (or only spaces) resets it; spaces around values are trimmed. The description is HTML and is shown on the storefront as is, without sanitizing. A variation of a product not in the site tree gives 404, no field at all — 422.

Body:
- `product_variation_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product variation id (`variations` of `stock/product/show`).
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the texts are written in its language; `null` or omitted — the default variation.
- `name` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Name of the product variation on the site, plain text; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string (or only spaces) — reset. Spaces around are trimmed.
- `description` (string or null, length ≤ 100000): Description of the product variation on the site, HTML; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset. The storefront outputs the HTML as is, without sanitizing: pass only markup you trust.

Response 200, `data`:
- `product_variation_id` (integer): Product variation id.
- `product_id` (integer): Product id of the variation.
- `locale` (string): Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).
- `name` (string or null): Name of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the name of the product on the site, the common translation or the original name.
- `description` (string or null): Description of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Rubric

The rubric tree of the site, texts of a brand in a rubric, filter aspects of a rubric.

### Activate a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/activate` · `rubric_activate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Shows the rubric on the site (`active: true`). The flag is own: the rubric stays hidden while an ancestor is inactive.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
