- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List filter aspects of a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/aspect/list` · `rubric_aspect_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Aspects used as filters of a rubric of the site tree, in the order of the rubric filters, in the format of `aspect/batch-show`. Inactive and deleted aspects are left out. A rubric that is not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree` with `pointer` `#/rubric_id`, as `rubric_id` of `stock/*`. The values with the number of products — `stock/facet/list` with this `rubric_id`.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id of the site tree (`rubric/list`); a rubric that is not in the tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the names are in its language; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of the site variation, the source name if there is no translation; the same `name` as in `aspects` of products.
- `type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront: `size` — sizes (a size picker, values from small to large, a size chart), `color` — colours (values may have `color_hex_code`); `null` — an ordinary aspect.
- `aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id (`aspect/group/list`); 0 is the virtual «General characteristics» group for an aspect without a group.
- `aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name in the language of the site variation.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show a brand in a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/brand/show` · `rubric_brand_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

The page of the brand in a rubric of the site tree with its texts: one entry for each language of the site, a field without a text is null (the storefront then shows its own text). A `rubric_id` not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`, a brand closed for the site — 404.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id of the site tree (`rubric/list`); a rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `brand_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Brand id visible on the site (`brand/search`); another one gives 404.

Response 200, `data`:
- `rubric_id` (integer): Rubric id of the site tree.
- `brand_id` (integer): Brand id.
- `rubric_name` (string): Rubric name.
- `brand_name` (string): Brand name.
- `url` (string): Page on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site, one entry for each language of the site; a field without a text is null.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1).
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.
- `translations[].meta_lead` (string or null): Lead text under the heading.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update texts of a brand in a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/brand/update` · `rubric_brand_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Changes texts of the page of the brand in a rubric by locale: an omitted or null field stays as it is, an empty string clears the text. A locale of another site gives 422 with `pointer` to it, a `rubric_id` not in the site tree — 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`, a brand closed for the site — 404.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id of the site tree (`rubric/list`); a rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `brand_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Brand id visible on the site (`brand/search`); another one gives 404.
- `translations` (array of object, items 1..50): Texts to change, by locale of the site.
- `translations[].locale` (string, required, length ≤ 10): Locale of the site, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Page heading (h1); an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Meta title; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta description; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta keywords; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `translations[].meta_lead` (string or null, length ≤ 5000): Lead text under the heading; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

Response 200, `data`:
- `rubric_id` (integer): Rubric id of the site tree.
- `brand_id` (integer): Brand id.
- `rubric_name` (string): Rubric name.
- `brand_name` (string): Brand name.
- `url` (string): Page on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site, one entry for each language of the site; a field without a text is null.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1).
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.
- `translations[].meta_lead` (string or null): Lead text under the heading.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Create a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/create` · `rubric_create` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Creates a rubric in the site tree under `parent_id` (a root without it) with translations, description and meta of the site variations, templates and menu flags. The new rubric is active and shown on the site at once: to fill it before showing, call `rubric/deactivate` right after creation. Without `position` it goes after the last sibling. A slug is made from the name and a taken one gets a numeric suffix (`-two`); a name without Latin letters or digits after transliteration (`!!!`) needs `slug`. A given `slug` must be lowercase Latin letters and digits separated by hyphens; a taken one gives 422. A `parent_id` not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `name` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Rubric name; spaces around it are trimmed.
- `parent_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Parent rubric of the site tree (`rubric/list`); null — a root rubric.
- `slug` (string or null, length ≤ 255, pattern `^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)$`): URL slug: lowercase Latin letters and digits separated by single hyphens; a taken one gives 422. Without it the slug is made from the name, and a taken one gets a numeric suffix (`-two`).
- `position` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Order among the siblings, ascending; after the last sibling by default (its position + 10).
- `context` (string or null, length ≤ 10000): Context for text generation.
- `partner_tag` (string or null, length ≤ 4096): Partner tag; an empty string means no tag.
- `banned` (boolean or null): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean or null): A selection (a rubric built by a filter): changing it recalculates primary rubrics of products.
- `in_top_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the full menu.
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean or null): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Document template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Layout template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.
- `translations` (array of object, items ≤ 50): Translations to change, by locale of the site.
- `translations[].locale` (string, required, length ≤ 10): Locale of the site, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Short name; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Full name; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null, length ≤ 255): «What» phrase for texts; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 1 item; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 2 items; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 10 items; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo` (array of object, items ≤ 50): Description and meta to change, by site variation.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string, required, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the default variation.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Meta title; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta description; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta keywords; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.

Response 201, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Deactivate a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/deactivate` · `rubric_deactivate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Hides the rubric on the site (`active: false`) together with its subtree on the storefront; `active` of the descendants does not change.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Delete a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/delete` · `rubric_delete` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Deletes a rubric without child rubrics together with its product links, translations and SEO; the parent becomes a leaf when it was the last child. The products of the rubric get their main rubric, restrictions and search index recalculated in the queue within minutes. A rubric with children gives 409: move or delete them first. A rubric used by settings of the platform (banners, brand and supplier lists of the rubric, filters, exports) gives 409 `rubric-in-use` listing them: turn it off with `rubric/deactivate` instead.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.

Response 204, `data`:
- no fields

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 409: `/api/problems/conflict`, `/api/problems/rubric-in-use`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List rubrics of the site

`POST /v2/rubric/list` · `rubric_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Rubrics of the site tree ordered by level, position and id, page by page (`meta.pager`): the whole tree, the children of `parent_id` or all its descendants (`with_descendants`), or only `ids`. Each row carries what a menu and breadcrumbs need, so the whole menu is built from this list without `rubric/show` per rubric: the menu flags (`in_top_menu`, `in_all_menu`, `in_footer_menu`, `unfold`, `unfold_count`), `local_name` in the language of `site_variation` and `ancestors` from the root. `active` is the own flag of the rubric: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. `product_count` — products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics by the search index, as `stock/product/search` finds them; `non_empty=true` leaves out rubrics without products. Translations, description and meta are in `rubric/show`. A `parent_id` not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`, `with_descendants` without `parent_id` — 422.

Body:
- `parent_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Children of this rubric of the site tree; without it — the whole tree. A rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `with_descendants` (boolean, default false): With `parent_id`: all descendants, not only the direct children; without `parent_id` gives 422.
- `max_level` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only rubrics down to this depth, 1 — the roots.
- `active` (boolean or null): Only active (true) or only inactive (false) rubrics, by the own flag `active`.
- `partner_tag` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Only rubrics with this partner tag; an empty string is the same as no filter.
- `non_empty` (boolean, default false): Only rubrics with products (`product_count` above 0); false — all rubrics.
- `ids` (array of integer or null, items 1..1000, item 1..2147483647): Only these rubrics, up to 1000; ids of other trees are skipped.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): `local_name` is in its language; the default variation if omitted.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..1000, default 500): Page size, 1 to 1000, 500 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation`, as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation (`translations[].name` of `rubric/show`), `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` of `rubric/show` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted (rubrics of a source store).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Move a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/move` · `rubric_move` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Moves a rubric with its subtree under `parent_id` of the site tree, or to the root without it, to `position` among the new siblings (after the last one without it). Paths and levels of the subtree and `leaf` of both parents are recalculated; the request returns at once, and the links of the subtree products to the ancestors (added to the new ones, removed from the old ones unless the product has other links there) and the search index are recalculated in the background within minutes. With the same parent only `position` changes. A parent from the subtree of the rubric gives 422, a parent not in the site tree — 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): New parent rubric of the site tree (`rubric/list`); null — make it a root rubric.
- `position` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Order among the new siblings, ascending (`position` of `rubric/list`); without it — after the last sibling. With the same parent only the position changes.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Search rubrics of the site

`POST /v2/rubric/search` · `rubric_search` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Rubrics of the site tree with the text in the name, slug, translations, description or meta of the site, page by page, in the format of `rubric/list` and with its filters (`parent_id`, `with_descendants`, `max_level`, `active`, `partner_tag`, `non_empty`, `site_variation`).

Body:
- `query` (string, required, length 2..200): Text in the name, slug, translations, description or meta of the site.
- `parent_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only children of this rubric of the site tree. A rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `with_descendants` (boolean, default false): With `parent_id`: all descendants, not only the direct children; without `parent_id` gives 422.
- `max_level` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only rubrics down to this depth.
- `active` (boolean or null): Only active (true) or only inactive (false) rubrics, by the own flag `active`.
- `partner_tag` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Only rubrics with this partner tag; an empty string is the same as no filter.
- `non_empty` (boolean, default false): Only rubrics with products (`product_count` above 0); false — all rubrics.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): `local_name` is in its language; the default variation if omitted.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..1000, default 500): Page size, 1 to 1000, 500 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation`, as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation (`translations[].name` of `rubric/show`), `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` of `rubric/show` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted (rubrics of a source store).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/show` · `rubric_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

A rubric of the site tree: the fields of `rubric/list` with translations, description and meta of each site variation (`seo`, one entry per variation, a field without a text is null), templates and auto landing pages. `breadcrumbs` are the base names of the ancestors, `translations[].breadcrumbs` — their full names in the language. A rubric of another tree gives 404.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): `local_name` is in its language; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update a rubric

`POST /v2/rubric/update` · `rubric_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Changes the given fields of a rubric of the site tree: an omitted or null field stays as it is, an empty string clears a text (translations, `seo`, `context`) and `partner_tag` removes the tag. Translations and SEO change per locale and variation. A blank name, a slug not of lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, or a taken slug gives 422 with `pointer`; so does a locale or variation of another site. To move a rubric use `rubric/move`.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Rubric id.
- `name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Rubric name; spaces around it are trimmed, a blank one gives 422.
- `slug` (string or null, length ≤ 255, pattern `^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)$`): URL slug: lowercase Latin letters and digits separated by single hyphens; a taken one gives 422.
- `position` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `context` (string or null, length ≤ 10000): Context for text generation; an empty string clears it.
- `partner_tag` (string or null, length ≤ 4096): Partner tag; an empty string removes it.
- `banned` (boolean or null): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean or null): A selection (a rubric built by a filter): changing it recalculates primary rubrics of products.
- `in_top_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the full menu.
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean or null): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean or null): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): How many children are unfolded.
- `auto_landing` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean or null): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Document template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Layout template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.
- `translations` (array of object, items ≤ 50): Translations to change, by locale of the site.
- `translations[].locale` (string, required, length ≤ 10): Locale of the site, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Short name; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Full name; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null, length ≤ 255): «What» phrase for texts; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 1 item; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 2 items; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Form for 10 items; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo` (array of object, items ≤ 50): Description and meta to change, by site variation.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string, required, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the default variation.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Meta title; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta description; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta keywords; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Rubric name: the base name that `rubric/update` writes.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in the answers of the writing operations — of the default variation), as the storefront menu shows it: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the site»: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. A new rubric is active.
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `breadcrumbs` (string): `name` of the ancestors from the root, separated by ` / `; empty for a root rubric. Breadcrumbs in a language — `translations[].breadcrumbs` (full names).
- `partner_tag` (string or null): Partner tag of the rubric; null — none.
- `url` (string or null): Rubric page on the site; null for the shared catalogue tree.
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics, in stock by the search index — the `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with this `rubric_id`; null — not counted: the answers of the writing operations (`rubric/create`, `rubric/update`, …), take it from `rubric/show`.
- `context` (string): Context for text generation.
- `banned` (boolean): Banned on the site.
- `selection` (boolean): A selection (a rubric built by a filter).
- `in_top_menu` (boolean): Shown in the top menu.
- `in_all_menu` (boolean): Shown in the full menu («all categories»).
- `in_footer_menu` (boolean): Shown in the footer menu.
- `unfold` (boolean): Children are unfolded in the menu.
- `unfold_count` (integer): How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.
- `auto_landing` (boolean): Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.
- `auto_landing_expand` (integer): Depth of auto landing pages.
- `auto_landing_on_index` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.
- `auto_landing_in_catalog` (boolean): Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `seo` (array of object): Description and meta, one entry for each variation of the site (`settings/site-variation/list`); a field without a text is null.
- `seo[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`); `default` — the variation with an empty code.
- `seo[].description` (string or null): Rubric description, HTML.
- `seo[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `seo[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `seo[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `seo[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Brand

Brands of the site: list, search, texts, show and hide.

### Show a brand on the site

`POST /v2/brand/activate` · `brand_activate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Removes the brand from the brands hidden by the partner: it and its products are shown on the site again, the brand comes back to `brand/list`. The cache of the site is reset.

Body:
- `brand_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Brand id.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `autologo` (string): Absolute URL of a logo generated from the name on the CDN of the site, for a brand without `logo`.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `synonyms` (array of string): Search synonyms.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1) of the brand page; null — not set by the site.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML as stored: the storefront outputs it without sanitizing.
- `translations[].short_description` (string or null): Short description.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Hide a brand on the site

`POST /v2/brand/deactivate` · `brand_deactivate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Hides the brand and its products on the site: the brand leaves `brand/list` and comes in `brand/list-denied`. The cache of the site is reset.

Body:
- `brand_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Brand id.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `autologo` (string): Absolute URL of a logo generated from the name on the CDN of the site, for a brand without `logo`.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `synonyms` (array of string): Search synonyms.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1) of the brand page; null — not set by the site.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML as stored: the storefront outputs it without sanitizing.
- `translations[].short_description` (string or null): Short description.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List brands with products on the site

`POST /v2/brand/list` · `brand_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Brands that have products on the site by the search index, page by page (`meta.pager`), with `product_count` — the same selection as `stock/product/search` and `stock/facet/list`: restrictions of the site, the delivery country of `site_variation` (or `country`), `in_stock`, with `rubric_id` — products of the rubric with its subrubrics. So `product_count` equals `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with `brand_ids: [id]` and the same fields. `meta.cache.brand_product_counts.generated_at` tells when these counts were calculated; `expires_at` — when the 120-second cache expires. Brands closed for the site by the platform and brands hidden by the partner are left out (hidden ones — `brand/list-denied`); a brand without products — `brand/search`. `sort`: by name (default) or by the number of products. A rubric not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `rubric_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only brands with products in this rubric of the site rubric tree (`rubric/list`), with its subrubrics; a rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `in_stock` (boolean, default true): Count only products in stock by the search index, as `in_stock` of `stock/product/search`. False — also products without stock, but only if the site shows them (`shows_out_of_stock_products` of `settings/info/show`).
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): its delivery country decides which products are on the site; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null, length 2..2): Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, as `country` of `stock/product/search`.
- `sort` (string: `name_asc` | `name_desc` | `product_count_desc` | `product_count_asc`, default `name_asc`): Order of the brands.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..1000, default 500): Page size, 1 to 1000, 500 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the brand on the site by the search index. `brand/list` — equals `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with `brand_ids: [id]` and the same `rubric_id`, `in_stock`, `site_variation`, `country`; `brand/search` — the same in the default variation, in stock, 0 for a brand without products or hidden by the partner; `brand/list-denied` — always null (products of a hidden brand are not on the site).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List brands hidden on the site

`POST /v2/brand/list-denied` · `brand_list_denied` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Brands hidden by the partner with `brand/deactivate`, by id, page by page (`meta.pager`). They are not in `brand/list`; `product_count` is null: products of a hidden brand are not on the site. Show a brand again — `brand/activate`.

Body:
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..1000, default 500): Page size.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the brand on the site by the search index. `brand/list` — equals `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with `brand_ids: [id]` and the same `rubric_id`, `in_stock`, `site_variation`, `country`; `brand/search` — the same in the default variation, in stock, 0 for a brand without products or hidden by the partner; `brand/list-denied` — always null (products of a hidden brand are not on the site).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Search brands

`POST /v2/brand/search` · `brand_search` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Brands visible to the site with the text in the name, slug, synonyms or the site texts `h1`, `meta_title`, `meta_keywords`, page by page (`meta.pager`). Finds brands without products on the site and brands hidden by the partner too (`active`). Order: brands whose name starts with the text, then brands with products on the site, then the rest, each by name. Without `query` — all brands visible to the site in this order. `product_count` — products in the default variation, in stock; 0 without products.

Body:
- `query` (string or null, length ≤ 200): Text in the brand name, slug, synonyms or the site texts `h1`, `meta_title`, `meta_keywords` (descriptions are not searched). Spaces at the edges are ignored; omitted, an empty text or only spaces — all brands visible to the site.
- `active` (boolean or null): Only shown (true) or only hidden by the partner (false) brands.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size, 1 to 100, 50 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `product_count` (integer or null): Products of the brand on the site by the search index. `brand/list` — equals `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with `brand_ids: [id]` and the same `rubric_id`, `in_stock`, `site_variation`, `country`; `brand/search` — the same in the default variation, in stock, 0 for a brand without products or hidden by the partner; `brand/list-denied` — always null (products of a hidden brand are not on the site).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show a brand

`POST /v2/brand/show` · `brand_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

A brand visible to the site with synonyms, texts of the site by locale and templates. A brand closed for the site by the platform gives 404; a brand hidden by the partner is shown with `active: false`.

Body:
- `brand_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Brand id; or pass `slug` instead.
- `slug` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Brand slug of the storefront address (`/brand/<slug>`, `slug` of `brand/show`) instead of `brand_id`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `autologo` (string): Absolute URL of a logo generated from the name on the CDN of the site, for a brand without `logo`.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `synonyms` (array of string): Search synonyms.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1) of the brand page; null — not set by the site.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML as stored: the storefront outputs it without sanitizing.
- `translations[].short_description` (string or null): Short description.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update texts of a brand

`POST /v2/brand/update` · `brand_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Changes texts of the brand on the site by locale and its templates. An omitted or `null` field stays as it is; an empty string (or only spaces) resets the text to `null`; spaces around values are trimmed. `doc_template_id`/`layout_template_id` 0 removes the assignment. The description is HTML and is shown on the storefront as is, without sanitizing. The shared brand catalogue does not change; the cache of the site is reset, so the storefront shows the new texts at once. Each locale at most once in `translations`; a locale of another site or a repeated one gives 422 at `#/translations/<i>/locale`, a template of another site or of a wrong kind — 422 at its field, no text and no template — 422.

Body:
- `brand_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Brand id.
- `translations` (array of object, items ≤ 50): Texts to change, by locale of the site, each locale at most once; a text not passed stays as it is.
- `translations[].locale` (string, required, length ≤ 10): Locale of the site (`locales` of `settings/site-variation/list`), e.g. `ru`; each locale at most once in `translations`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Page heading (h1) of the brand page; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string (or only spaces) — reset to `null`. Spaces around are trimmed in every text field.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset. The storefront outputs the HTML as is, without sanitizing (scripts and styles included): pass only markup you trust.
- `translations[].short_description` (string or null, length ≤ 5000): Short description; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Meta title; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta description; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Meta keywords; omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Document template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null, 0..2147483647): Layout template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Brand id.
- `name` (string): Brand name.
- `slug` (string): URL slug.
- `url` (string): Absolute URL of the brand page on the site (`https`, `http` only in a debug environment — the same scheme as `logo` and the URLs of `stock/*`).
- `logo` (string or null): Absolute URL of the logo on the CDN of the site; null — no logo.
- `autologo` (string): Absolute URL of a logo generated from the name on the CDN of the site, for a brand without `logo`.
- `active` (boolean): Shown on the site: false — hidden by the partner (`brand/deactivate`).
- `synonyms` (array of string): Search synonyms.
- `doc_template_id` (integer or null): Document template assigned on the site.
- `layout_template_id` (integer or null): Layout template assigned on the site.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts of the site by locale.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].h1` (string or null): Page heading (h1) of the brand page; null — not set by the site.
- `translations[].description` (string or null): Description, HTML as stored: the storefront outputs it without sanitizing.
- `translations[].short_description` (string or null): Short description.
- `translations[].meta_title` (string or null): Meta title.
- `translations[].meta_description` (string or null): Meta description.
- `translations[].meta_keywords` (string or null): Meta keywords.
- `translations[].meta_robots` (string or null): Meta robots.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Aspect

Aspects (characteristics), their values and groups.

### List aspects by ids

`POST /v2/aspect/batch-show` · `aspect_batch_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Up to 1000 aspects in the order of `aspect_ids`, in the language of the site variation (`site_variation`). A repeated id comes once, at its first place; unknown ids and inactive or deleted aspects are left out without an error, so the answer may be shorter than the request: match the items by `id`. A read with the ids in the body.

Body:
- `aspect_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..1000, item 1..2147483647): Aspect ids, 1 to 1000: `aspects[].id` and `params[].aspect_id` of products, `aspects[].id` of `stock/facet/list`. Repeated ids come once.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the names are in its language; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of the site variation, the source name if there is no translation; the same `name` as in `aspects` of products.
- `type` (string: `size` | `color` or null): Special aspect of the storefront: `size` — sizes (a size picker, values from small to large, a size chart), `color` — colours (values may have `color_hex_code`); `null` — an ordinary aspect.
- `aspect_group_id` (integer): Aspect group id (`aspect/group/list`); 0 is the virtual «General characteristics» group for an aspect without a group.
- `aspect_group` (string): Aspect group name in the language of the site variation.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List aspect groups

`POST /v2/aspect/group/list` · `aspect_group_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

All aspect groups in the language of the site variation (`site_variation`), by `position`; groups with the same `position` — by `id`. The virtual group `id: 0` contains aspects without a group. Aspects inside a group have no order of their own: show them in the order of the answer that gave them (`aspect/batch-show` — the order of `aspect_ids`, a product — the order of its `aspects`, `rubric/aspect/list` and `stock/facet/list` — the order of the rubric filters).

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the names are in its language; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Aspect group id; 0 is the virtual group for aspects without a group.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of the site variation; the source name if there is no translation.
- `position` (integer): Order of the groups, ascending; groups with the same position go by `id`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List aspect values by ids

`POST /v2/aspect/param/batch-show` · `aspect_param_batch_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Up to 1000 values (params) in the order of `param_ids`, in the language of the site variation (`site_variation`). A repeated id comes once, at its first place; unknown ids, inactive values and values of an inactive or deleted aspect are left out without an error, as in products, so the answer may be shorter than the request: match the items by `id`. A read with the ids in the body.

Body:
- `param_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..1000, item ≥ 1): Param ids, 1 to 1000: `params[].id` and `property_param_ids` of products, `param_ids` and `property_param_ids` of their variations, `aspects[].values[].id` of `stock/facet/list`. Repeated ids come once.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the values are in its language; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Param id.
- `name` (string): Value in the language of the site variation, the source value if there is no translation; the same `name` as in `params` of products.
- `aspect_id` (integer): Aspect id.
- `color_hex_code` (string or null): Colour of the value as `#RRGGBB` for a colour swatch, the same as the storefront filter shows; `null` — no colour is set (most values, including most values of `color` aspects).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Source

Source stores of products and their rubrics.

### List rubrics of a source store

`POST /v2/source/store-rubric/list` · `source_store_rubric_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Rubrics of the tree of a source store from `source/store/list` ordered by level, position and id, page by page (`meta.pager`): the whole tree, the children of `parent_id` or all its descendants. Each rubric comes with its ancestors and translations, `local_name` is in the language of `site_variation` of the site of the token; menu flags and partner tags are settings of the rubrics of the site and are not here. `url` is the page on the source store, not on the site of the partner. Products of a source rubric with its subrubrics — `stock/product/id/list` with `store_id` and `rubric_id`; link them to the site tree with `product/rubric/link`. A site that is not a source store gives 404, a `parent_id` of another tree — 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

Body:
- `store_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Source store id from `source/store/list`.
- `parent_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Children of this rubric of the source tree; without it — the whole tree. A rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.
- `with_descendants` (boolean, default false): With `parent_id`: all descendants, not only the direct children; without `parent_id` gives 422.
- `max_level` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only rubrics down to this depth, 1 — the roots.
- `active` (boolean or null): Only active (true) or only inactive (false) rubrics, by the own flag `active`.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code of the site of the token (`settings/site-variation/list`): `local_name` is in its language; the default variation if omitted.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..1000, default 500): Page size, 1 to 1000, 500 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Rubric id of the source tree: pass it as `rubric_id` with `store_id` to `stock/product/id/list`.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric id; null — a root rubric.
- `name` (string): Base name of the rubric.
- `local_name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation`: the short name of the translation, `name` if there is none.
- `slug` (string): URL slug on the source store.
- `level` (integer): Depth in the tree, from 1 for a root rubric.
- `position` (integer): Order among the siblings, ascending.
- `active` (boolean): Own flag «shown on the source store».
- `leaf` (boolean): Has no child rubrics.
- `ancestors` (array of object): Ancestors from the root to the parent; empty for a root rubric.
- `ancestors[].id` (integer): Rubric id.
- `ancestors[].name` (string): Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.
- `ancestors[].slug` (string): URL slug.
- `translations` (array of object): Translations in every language the rubric has: names, breadcrumbs and phrases for texts.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale, e.g. `ru`.
- `translations[].name` (string or null): Short name.
- `translations[].full_name` (string or null): Full name.
- `translations[].breadcrumbs` (string): Ancestors from the root in this locale, separated by ` / `: the full name of the translation (`full_name`), else its short name, else `name` of the rubric. Unlike `breadcrumbs` of the rubric (base names).
- `translations[].what_phrase` (string or null): «What» phrase for texts: «смартфоны».
- `translations[].phrase1` (string or null): Form for 1 item.
- `translations[].phrase2` (string or null): Form for 2 items.
- `translations[].phrase10` (string or null): Form for 10 items.
- `url` (string or null): Page of the rubric on the site of the source store (its own domain), not on the site of the partner; null for the shared catalogue tree.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List source stores

`POST /v2/source/store/list` · `source_store_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Source stores available for mapping the catalogue of the site: their rubric trees are in `source/store-rubric/list`, products of a source rubric — `stock/product/id/list` with `store_id`. The body is an empty object.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Source store id (site id).
- `name` (string): Source store name.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Content

Articles, page templates and layouts of the site.

### List article types

`POST /v2/content/article-type/list` · `content_article_type_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Types of service pages and the article of the site that has each type now (`article_id`, `null` — the storefront shows its default page). A type belongs to one article of the site: `content/article/update` with `article_type_id` moves it, `0` removes it; an article with a type cannot be deleted.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Type id: pass it as `article_type_id` to `content/article/update`.
- `code` (string): Code of the page: `homepage`, `brand`, `empty-cart`, `empty-search`, `error403`, `error404`, `error500`.
- `name` (string): Name of the type (Russian, as in the admin panel).
- `article_id` (integer or null): Article of the site that has this type now; `null` — none, the storefront shows its default page.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Activate an article

`POST /v2/content/article/activate` · `content_article_activate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Shows the article in the lists and menus of the site again (`active: true`), in all variations. The response is the article in `site_variation`.

Body:
- `article_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Article id of the site (`content/article/list`).
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`) of the article in the response; omitted, `null` or `default` — the default variation. The flag itself is common to all variations.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Article id.
- `name` (string): Title.
