- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update a theme

`POST /v2/settings/theme/update` · `settings_theme_update` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Changes the given fields of a theme of the site; an omitted or null field stays as it is. A shared theme or a theme of another site gives 404.

Body:
- `theme_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Theme id of the site.
- `name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Theme name; spaces around are trimmed, an empty one (or only spaces) gives 422.
- `slug` (string or null, length ≤ 255, pattern `^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*)$`): Slug unique in the site.
- `vars` (string or null, length ≤ 2097152): CSS variables, up to 2 MB.
- `styles` (string or null, length ≤ 2097152): CSS, up to 2 MB.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Theme id.
- `name` (string): Theme name.
- `slug` (string): Slug in the site; a shared theme ends with `-default`.
- `hash` (string): Hash of the CSS: changes with `vars` and `styles`.
- `global` (boolean): Shared theme of the platform: read-only.
- `active` (boolean): The storefront of the site uses this theme now (setting `default_theme`, changed with `settings/variable/save`).
- `css_url` (string): URL of the built CSS file.
- `vars` (string or null): CSS variables; only in `settings/theme/show`.
- `styles` (string or null): CSS; only in `settings/theme/show`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List icons of settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/icon/list` · `settings_variable_icon_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Icons that `icon_name` of settings and rubrics refers to, with SVG in six styles. An `icon_name` not in the list is a name of the icon package of the admin panel.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `name` (string): Icon name: `icon_name` of `settings/variable/list` and `settings/variable/rubric/list`.
- `svg_solid_sm` (string or null): SVG, solid, small.
- `svg_solid_lg` (string or null): SVG, solid, large.
- `svg_outline_sm` (string or null): SVG, outline, small.
- `svg_outline_lg` (string or null): SVG, outline, large.
- `svg_color_sm` (string or null): SVG, color, small.
- `svg_color_lg` (string or null): SVG, color, large.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/list` · `settings_variable_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Settings of the site available to the partner, page by page (`meta.pager`), in the order of rubrics and positions: one `value` for `global`, `values` per site variation for `variation`. Texts (`name`, `description`, labels of `allowed_values`) are in the language of `site_variation`; texts in every language — with `with_translations: true`. Filters: `rubric_id` (`settings/variable/rubric/list`), `codes`, `type`, `query` (text in the code, name or description).

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of `name`, `description` and labels of `allowed_values`; the default variation if omitted.
- `rubric_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Only variables of this settings rubric (`settings/variable/rubric/list`), without its subrubrics.
- `codes` (array of string, items ≤ 200): Only variables with these codes.
- `type` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Only variables of this value type (`type` of the item: `twig`, `switch`, `select`, …).
- `query` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Text in the code, name or description in the language of `site_variation`, case-insensitive.
- `with_translations` (boolean, default false): Add `translations`: texts in every language that has any.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..500, default 100): Page size, 1 to 500, 100 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `code` (string): Variable code.
- `type` (string): Value type: `string`, `text`, `textarea`, `switch`, `select`, `twig`, `file`, …
- `scope` (string): `global` — one value for the site, `variation` — a value per site variation.
- `nullable` (boolean): An empty value is allowed.
- `readonly` (boolean): Read-only for the partner: `settings/variable/save` and `reset` give 422.
- `secret` (boolean): A secret: values are masked (`abc***xyz`); send a new value to change it.
- `rubric_id` (integer or null): Settings rubric: `id` of `settings/variable/rubric/list`.
- `icon_name` (string or null): Icon: `name` of `settings/variable/icon/list` or a name of the icon package of the admin panel.
- `position` (integer): Order in the rubric.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (English if there is no text in it, then Russian).
- `description` (string): Description in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `keywords` (string): Search keywords in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `sub_title` (string): Subtitle in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `twig_type` (string or null): Root type of the template context of a `twig` variable: a key of `types` in `settings/variable/twig-context`; `null` for other types.
- `default_value` (string): Default value.
- `value` (string or null): Value of a `global` variable; login and password in a URL or DSN are masked (`smtp://***:***@host:25`).
- `values` (array of object): Values of a `variation` variable by site variation.
- `values[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code; `default` — the variation without a code.
- `values[].value` (string): Current value; a secret is masked.
- `values[].default_value` (string): Default value of the variation.
- `allowed_values` (object): Allowed values of a `select` or `switch`: value → label in the language of `site_variation`; `{}` — any value.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts in every language that has any; empty without `with_translations: true`.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale.
- `translations[].name` (string): Name.
- `translations[].description` (string): Description.
- `translations[].keywords` (string): Search keywords.
- `translations[].sub_title` (string): Subtitle.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Reset settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/reset` · `settings_variable_reset` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Resets settings to their defaults in a site variation and returns the values in effect. A read-only setting gives 422 with `pointer` to its code.

Body:
- `codes` (array of string, items 1..200): Variable codes.
- `site_variation` (string, required, length ≤ 50): Site variation of `variation` variables; `default` — the variation without a code.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `code` (string): Variable code.
- `value` (string): Stored value; a secret is masked.
- `scope` (string): `global` or `variation`.
- `site_variation` (string or null): Site variation of a `variation` variable; `default` — the variation without a code.
- `skipped` (boolean): The value was not written: it is the mask of a secret read from the API.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List rubrics of settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/rubric/list` · `settings_variable_rubric_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

The tree of rubrics (sections and groups) that settings belong to (`rubric_id` of `settings/variable/list`), parents before children, names in the language of `site_variation`. The tree is the same for every site.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of names; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Rubric id: `rubric_id` of `settings/variable/list`.
- `parent_id` (integer or null): Parent rubric; `null` — a root section.
- `level` (integer): Depth: 0 — a root section.
- `slug` (string): Slug.
- `path` (string): Names from the root to the rubric, ` / ` between them, in the language of `site_variation`.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (English if there is no text in it, then Russian).
- `description` (string): Description in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `keywords` (string): Search keywords in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `sub_title` (string): Subtitle in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `icon_name` (string or null): Icon: `name` of `settings/variable/icon/list` or a name of the icon package of the admin panel.
- `svg` (string or null): SVG of the icon (outline, large) if it is in `settings/variable/icon/list`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Save settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/save` · `settings_variable_save` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Saves values of settings in a site variation as one batch: all or none. A hidden setting gives 404, a read-only one or a value that does not pass the check — 422 with `pointer` to the item; a numeric setting takes only a number (`15`, `12.5`). A mask of a secret is skipped (`skipped: true`). A theme of the storefront is chosen with `default_theme` (`{"themeId": <id of settings/theme/list>}`).

Body:
- `variables` (array of object, items 1..200): Values to save.
- `variables[].code` (string, required, pattern `^([a-z0-9_]+)$`): Variable code.
- `variables[].value` (any): Value; null or empty — empty value (allowed for a nullable variable). A file — a base64 data URL.
- `site_variation` (string, required, length ≤ 50): Site variation of `variation` variables; `default` — the variation without a code.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `code` (string): Variable code.
- `value` (string): Stored value; a secret is masked.
- `scope` (string): `global` or `variation`.
- `site_variation` (string or null): Site variation of a `variation` variable; `default` — the variation without a code.
- `skipped` (boolean): The value was not written: it is the mask of a secret read from the API.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show a setting

`POST /v2/settings/variable/show` · `settings_variable_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

A setting of the site available to the partner, texts in the language of `site_variation`. A hidden one gives 404.

Body:
- `code` (string, required, length ≤ 128, pattern `^[a-z0-9_]+$`): Variable code.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of `name`, `description` and labels of `allowed_values`; the default variation if omitted.
- `with_translations` (boolean, default false): Add `translations`: texts in every language that has any.

Response 200, `data`:
- `code` (string): Variable code.
- `type` (string): Value type: `string`, `text`, `textarea`, `switch`, `select`, `twig`, `file`, …
- `scope` (string): `global` — one value for the site, `variation` — a value per site variation.
- `nullable` (boolean): An empty value is allowed.
- `readonly` (boolean): Read-only for the partner: `settings/variable/save` and `reset` give 422.
- `secret` (boolean): A secret: values are masked (`abc***xyz`); send a new value to change it.
- `rubric_id` (integer or null): Settings rubric: `id` of `settings/variable/rubric/list`.
- `icon_name` (string or null): Icon: `name` of `settings/variable/icon/list` or a name of the icon package of the admin panel.
- `position` (integer): Order in the rubric.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (English if there is no text in it, then Russian).
- `description` (string): Description in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `keywords` (string): Search keywords in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `sub_title` (string): Subtitle in the language of `site_variation`, the same fallback.
- `twig_type` (string or null): Root type of the template context of a `twig` variable: a key of `types` in `settings/variable/twig-context`; `null` for other types.
- `default_value` (string): Default value.
- `value` (string or null): Value of a `global` variable; login and password in a URL or DSN are masked (`smtp://***:***@host:25`).
- `values` (array of object): Values of a `variation` variable by site variation.
- `values[].site_variation` (string): Site variation code; `default` — the variation without a code.
- `values[].value` (string): Current value; a secret is masked.
- `values[].default_value` (string): Default value of the variation.
- `allowed_values` (object): Allowed values of a `select` or `switch`: value → label in the language of `site_variation`; `{}` — any value.
- `translations` (array of object): Texts in every language that has any; empty without `with_translations: true`.
- `translations[].locale` (string): Locale.
- `translations[].name` (string): Name.
- `translations[].description` (string): Description.
- `translations[].keywords` (string): Search keywords.
- `translations[].sub_title` (string): Subtitle.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show the template context of settings

`POST /v2/settings/variable/twig-context` · `settings_variable_twig_context` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

What a `twig` setting can use in its template: types of the context with fields and methods, and Twig filters. A setting starts from its `twig_type` (`settings/variable/list`): `{{ productName }}` for `ProductPageTpl`; `type` of a member names the next type. Descriptions are in the language of `site_variation` (Russian if there is no text in it).

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of descriptions; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data`:
- `types` (array of object): Types of the template context: a `twig` variable starts from its `twig_type` (`settings/variable/list`), `type` of a member names the next type.
- `types[].name` (string): Type name: `twig_type` of a variable or `type` of a member.
- `types[].description` (string): What the type is, in the language of `site_variation` (Russian if there is no text in it).
- `types[].example` (string): Example of use in a template; empty if none.
- `types[].members` (array of object): Fields and methods of the type: `{{ product.name }}`, `{{ product.name.suffix(' — buy') }}`.
- `types[].members[].name` (string): Name in a template.
- `types[].members[].kind` (string): `property` — a field (`{{ type.name }}`), `function` — a method with arguments (`{{ type.name(args) }}`).
- `types[].members[].type` (string): Type of the value: a scalar (`string`, `int`, `float`, `bool`, `array`) or a name of another type of `types`.
- `types[].members[].description` (string): What the value is, in the language of `site_variation` (Russian if there is no text in it).
- `types[].members[].example` (string): Example value; empty if none.
- `types[].members[].args` (array of object): Arguments of a method in order; empty for a field.
- `filters` (array of object): Twig filters available in every template: `{{ name|lower }}`.
- `filters[].name` (string): Filter name: `{{ value|name }}`.
- `filters[].description` (string): What the filter does (Russian: the platform describes filters only in Russian).
- `filters[].example` (string): Example of use; empty if none.
- `filters[].args` (array of object): Arguments in order: `{{ count|plural('товар', 'товара', 'товаров', 'товаров') }}`.
- `filters[].args[].name` (string): Argument name.
- `filters[].args[].type` (string): Argument type: a scalar or a name of a type of `types`.
- `filters[].args[].description` (string): What to pass; empty if not described.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Dictionary

Reference data of the site: delivery countries, delivery methods, settlements.

### Search settlements

`POST /v2/dictionary/city/search` · `dictionary_city_search` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`) or customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Settlements of a delivery country of the site by a part of the name, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`. In Russia the source is the KLADR directory (without Crimea and Sevastopol, where the site does not deliver): names that start with `query` come first, then the other matches, larger settlements higher; `е` and `ё` are the same. `id` is the KLADR id: pass it as `city_id` to `delivery/calculate`, `delivery/pick-up-point/list` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`. In other countries it is a hint of the geocoder: it finds a city by its full name, `id` is `null`, pass the name as text (`recipient.city`). A country the site does not deliver to gives 422 `country-not-delivered` with `pointer` `#/country`.

Body:
- `query` (string, required, length 2..100): Beginning or part of the settlement name, at least 2 characters, in any case; in Russia `е` also finds `ё` (`Орел` finds `Орёл`).
- `country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `dictionary/country/list`, in any case; by default the primary country of the site.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (string or null): Settlement KLADR id (11 digits) in Russia: pass it as `city_id` to `delivery/calculate`, `delivery/pick-up-point/list` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`. `null` in other countries: there is no directory, pass the name as text (`recipient.city`).
- `name` (string): Name: a city by itself (`Москва`), a smaller settlement with its district and type (`Ибресинский р-н, п. Орел`); outside Russia — the name the geocoder found.
- `region` (string or null): Region name.
- `country` (string): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/country-not-delivered`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List delivery countries

`POST /v2/dictionary/country/list` · `dictionary_country_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`) or customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Countries the site of the token delivers to, in the order of the site settings: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in upper case and the name in the language of `site_variation`. Pass the code as `country` to delivery and order methods.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): country names are in its language; `null` or omitted — the default variation.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `code` (string): ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in upper case, e.g. `RU`: pass it as `country`.
- `name` (string): Country name in the requested language, e.g. `Russia`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List delivery methods

`POST /v2/dictionary/delivery-method/list` · `dictionary_delivery_method_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`) or customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Delivery methods enabled on the site with destination countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case, only the delivery countries of the site). A method that delivers to none of them, or is switched off by 4Partners, is not listed. The list does not promise that a particular cart can be shipped: `delivery/calculate` prices the methods for the cart and omits the ones it cannot ship. Names are in the language of `site_variation`. A method with `with_pick_up_points` delivers to pick-up points: take one from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` and pass it as `pick_up_point_id` to `order/create` (when it may be omitted — see `order/create`).

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): names are in its language; `null` or omitted — the default variation.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Delivery method id, pass it as `delivery_method_id`.
- `name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation`; the name in the delivery settings when it has no translation.
- `currency` (string or null): ISO 4217 currency of the delivery price on the site; `null` when the site sets none.
- `with_pick_up_points` (boolean): `true` — delivery to a pick-up point (`type: pick_up_point` in `delivery/calculate`): points — `delivery/pick-up-point/list`; when `order/create` needs `pick_up_point_id` — see `order/create`.
- `countries` (array of string): Destination countries, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: delivery countries of the site (`dictionary/country/list`) the method has a tariff to from at least one warehouse. Never empty: a method without destinations is not listed. Whether a particular cart can be shipped (warehouses of the items, weight, pick-up points) — `delivery/calculate`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Order

The partner (site owner) places, pays from its deposit and cancels orders; a package gives the link to the passport form for the recipient.

### List orders by ids

`POST /v2/order/batch-show` · `order_batch_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Up to 100 orders of the site in the order of `order_ids`, in the format of `order/show`: poll statuses, packages and tracking in one request instead of one request per order. Orders of other sites and unknown ids are left out.

Body:
- `order_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..100, item 1..2147483647): Order ids (O), 1 to 100; a repeated id is returned once.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Cancel an order

`POST /v2/order/cancel` · `order_cancel` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Cancels an order placed by the partner. Canceling a canceled order changes nothing and returns it (200). Orders of customers cannot be canceled (409). A sent or delivered order (status `sent`, `sent_msk` or `delivered`) cannot be canceled: 409 `/api/problems/order-shipped`, a return is arranged by 4Partners support. A canceled order keeps `is_paid`, `deposit_paid` and the prices of its items, `total_price` and `delivery_price` become `0.00`. The charged deposit is not returned automatically: an operator returns it, the returned amount is in `deposit_refunded`.

Body:
- `order_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Order id (O).

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 409: `/api/problems/order-canceled`, `/api/problems/order-already-paid`, `/api/problems/order-shipped`, `/api/problems/conflict`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Place an order

`POST /v2/order/create` · `order_create` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Places an order on behalf of the partner (the site owner) and returns it with `deposit_due`, the amount `order/pay` will charge. Prices may not be lower than the site prices (422 `/api/problems/price-below-site-price`); the quantity of a line may not exceed the stock of the product on the site (422, `pointer` to the quantity): products are not bought to order; `pick_up_point_id` must be a pick-up point of the delivery method; `currency` must be one the site has for the recipient country (422 `#/currency`). Use the same `country`, `recipient.city_id` (KLADR) and `pick_up_point_id` as in `delivery/calculate`: the delivery is charged as it showed. No passport is needed to place the order: when customs need one, the package has `passport_status` and `passport_link` — send the link to the recipient, who fills in the passport. A repeated request with the same `external_id` and the same body returns the order already created with status 200 and `replayed: true`, even after the subscription has expired; a different body gives 409 `/api/problems/external-id-conflict`. Business rule violations give 422 with the reason in `detail`, its own `type` where the client may act on it and `pointer` to the value of the body; an expired subscription of the site owner gives 403 `/api/problems/subscription-expired` (see `subscription_paid_until` of `settings/info/show`).

Body:
- `recipient` (object, required): Recipient and delivery address.
- `recipient.name` (string, required, length ≤ 255): First name.
- `recipient.surname` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Last name.
- `recipient.phone` (string, required, length ≤ 32, pattern `^((?=(?:\D*\d){10,15}\D*$)\+?[\d\s().-]+)$`): Phone with the country code: 10 to 15 digits. Spaces, `+`, `-`, `.` and brackets are allowed and dropped, `+7 (900) 000-00-00` is stored as `79000000000`; letters and other characters give 422.
- `recipient.email` (string, required): Email for delivery notifications.
- `recipient.country` (string, required): Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `POST /v2/dictionary/country/list`, in any case (`ru` and `RU` are the same).
- `recipient.patronymic` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Patronymic.
- `recipient.region` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Region.
- `recipient.city` (string or null, length ≤ 255): City (Russia), e.g. `Москва`; may be omitted with `city_id`. Outside Russia — the city of the address.
- `recipient.street` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Street (Russia).
- `recipient.house` (string or null, length ≤ 32): House (Russia).
- `recipient.building` (string or null, length ≤ 32): Building (Russia).
- `recipient.flat` (string or null, length ≤ 32): Flat (Russia).
- `recipient.zip` (string or null, length ≤ 16): Postal code.
- `recipient.address` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Full address in one line (outside Russia).
- `recipient.city_id` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{11,19})$`): Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search` (Russia only), the same `city_id` as in `delivery/calculate` and `delivery/pick-up-point/list`: the delivery price and the pick-up point chosen without `pick_up_point_id` are taken for it, as `delivery/calculate` showed. It wins over the settlement the address service finds by `city` and `street`; without `city` the name of the settlement is taken from KLADR. Without `city_id` the settlement is the one the address service finds by `city` and `street`, or none.
- `items` (array of object, required, items 1..100): Order lines.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product variation id.
- `items[].quantity` (integer, required, 1..1000): Quantity.
- `items[].price` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{1,8}(\.\d{1,2})?)$`): Sale price per unit in the order currency, decimal string. It may not be lower than the price of the variation on the site; without it the site price is used.
- `delivery_method_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Delivery method id from `delivery/calculate` (or `dictionary/delivery-method/list`).
- `pick_up_point_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Pick-up point id from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` of this delivery method, for pick-up delivery methods only (a door method gives 422 `pick-up-not-supported`). Pass it: the delivery is charged to this point, as `delivery/calculate` with the same `pick_up_point_id` showed. Without it the point is chosen only on a site with a default pick-up point in its settings (the point nearest to the address, or that default one); otherwise 422 `pick-up-point-required`.
- `external_id` (string or null, length ≤ 512): Order id in the partner system, makes the request safe to retry after a timeout. A repeated request with the id of a live (not canceled) order and the same items, `delivery_method_id`, `pick_up_point_id` and `currency` returns that order with status 200 and `replayed: true`; a different body gives 409 `/api/problems/external-id-conflict`. The recipient is not compared. An empty or blank value is the same as no id: the order is created without it and is never replayed.
- `currency` (string: `RUB` | `USD` | `EUR` or null): Order currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for the recipient country; by default the primary currency of the site for it. Another currency gives 422 `#/currency` with the allowed ones, before anything is saved.

Response 201, `data`:
- `order` (object): The order: placed by this request or, when `replayed`, by an earlier one with the same `external_id`.
- `order.id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `order.source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `order.customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `order.customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `order.customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `order.customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `order.customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `order.status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `order.created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `order.currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `order.total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `order.delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `order.is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `order.payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `order.payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `order.payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `order.deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `order.deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `order.deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `order.deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `order.external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `order.packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `order.packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `order.packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `order.packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `order.packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `order.packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `order.packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `order.packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `order.packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `order.packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.
- `replayed` (boolean): `true` — the request repeats an earlier one with the same `external_id` and the same body: no new order is placed, the earlier order is returned with status 200 (a new order gives 201).

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/forbidden`, `/api/problems/subscription-expired`, `/api/problems/owner-not-allowed`, `/api/problems/site-token-required`
- 409: `/api/problems/external-id-conflict`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/price-below-site-price`, `/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/country-not-delivered`, `/api/problems/variation-unavailable`, `/api/problems/delivery-method-not-on-site`, `/api/problems/pick-up-not-supported`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List orders of the site

`POST /v2/order/list` · `order_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Orders placed by the partner and by customers of the site, newest first, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`. Abandoned carts are not orders and are not listed. `external_id` finds the orders placed with this id, canceled ones included. `deposit_due` is `null` here: it is calculated only by `order/show` and `order/create`.

Body:
- `status` (string or null, length ≤ 32): Order status, e.g. `new`, `sent`, `canceled`.
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer` or null): `partner` — orders placed by the partner via the API, `customer` — by customers of the site.
- `external_id` (string or null, length ≤ 512): Order id in the partner system, exactly as passed to `order/create`: finds the orders placed with it, canceled ones included.
- `date_from` (string or null): Created on or after this day.
- `date_to` (string or null): Created on or before this day.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.

Errors:

- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`

### Pay an order from the deposit

`POST /v2/order/pay` · `order_pay` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Charges the partner price of the order with delivery (`deposit_due` of `order/show`) from the deposit of the site owner; the charge is in `deposit_paid`. Not enough deposit gives 409 `/api/problems/deposit-insufficient` and nothing is charged; a canceled order gives 409 `/api/problems/order-canceled`, an already paid one 409 `/api/problems/order-already-paid`. Parallel `order/pay` requests of the same order charge it once: the others get `order-already-paid`, or 409 `/api/problems/conflict` when the first one is still running (nothing charged by them, check `deposit_paid` with `order/show`).

Body:
- `order_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Order id (O).
- `deposit_currency` (string: `RUB` | `USD` | `EUR` or null): Deposit currency to charge; by default the order currency.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.

- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.

- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.

- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`

### Show an order

`POST /v2/order/show` · `order_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

An order of the site with packages and items. An unpaid order that is not canceled has `deposit_due`: what `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included. A package that needs the passport of the recipient has `passport_status` and `passport_link`: send the link to the recipient, the passport is filled in only by the form. An order of another site gives 404.

Body:
- `order_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Order id (O).

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `source` (string: `partner` | `customer`): Who placed the order.
- `customer` (object): Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).
- `customer.id` (integer): Customer id.
- `customer.name` (string or null): Name from the customer profile.
- `customer.email` (string or null): Email from the customer profile.
- `customer.phone` (string or null): Phone from the customer profile.
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.
- `total_price` (string): Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.
- `delivery_price` (string): Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `deposit_paid` (string or null): Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`; `null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.
- `deposit_refunded` (string or null): Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.
- `deposit_due` (string or null): What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.
- `deposit_currency` (string or null): Deposit currency of `deposit_paid`, `deposit_refunded` and `deposit_due`.
- `external_id` (string or null): Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
