- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Delivery

Delivery cost and pick-up points for an order of the partner.

### Calculate delivery

`POST /v2/delivery/calculate` · `delivery_calculate` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Delivery options for the items to the country (and city) of the recipient, priced as `order/create` will charge them; nothing is saved. Takes the same `items`, `country`, `currency`, `city_id` (`recipient.city_id` of the order) and `pick_up_point_id` as `order/create`: check the cart here, then order with the chosen `delivery_method_id`. Every delivery method of the site is in `options` (priced, cheapest first) or in `omitted` with the reason: `city_required` — a pick-up method without `city_id` or `pick_up_point_id`; `no_pick_up_points`; `too_heavy`; `country_not_served`; `warehouse_not_served` — a method must ship from the warehouses of all items at once, so a mixed-warehouse cart gets fewer methods (split it); `city_not_served` — Crimea and Sevastopol; `not_priced` — the tariff does not take an item (tyres). A pick-up method with `city_id` is priced at the most expensive point of the city (`price_is_upper_bound: true`); with `pick_up_point_id` — to that point. `delivery_date` is text for display, `delivery_date_iso` — the same date as `YYYY-MM-DD`; `weight_grams` — the weight the tariff priced. A price of `"0.00"` is valid. Rejected with 422 and `pointer`: a country the site does not deliver to (`country-not-delivered`), a currency the site has not for the country, a variation not sold on the site (`variation-unavailable`), a quantity above the stock (as in `order/create`: products are not bought to order), an item no tariff of the site can carry (`delivery-unavailable`), an inactive pick-up point.

Body:
- `items` (array of object, required, items 1..100): Cart lines. The quantity of a variation (summed over lines) may not exceed its stock on the site.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product variation id.
- `items[].quantity` (integer, required, 1..1000): Quantity.
- `items[].price` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{1,8}(\.\d{1,2})?)$`): Sale price per unit in `currency`, decimal string, the same as `items[].price` of `order/create`. The free delivery threshold of a tariff is checked against the cart total, so pass the prices you will order at; without it (or with `0`) the price of the variation on the site is used, as in `order/create` without `price`.
- `country` (string, required): Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `dictionary/country/list`, in any case (`ru` and `RU` are the same).
- `city_id` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{11,19})$`): Settlement KLADR id (Russia) from `dictionary/city/search`, the same as `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`.
- `pick_up_point_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Pick-up point id from `delivery/pick-up-point/list`: the pick-up method of its network is priced to this point, as `order/create` with this `pick_up_point_id` is charged. Without `city_id` the city of the point is used.
- `currency` (string: `RUB` | `USD` | `EUR` or null): Price currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for `country`; by default the primary currency of the site for it. A currency the site has not for the country gives 422 `#/currency` with the allowed ones.

Response 200, `data`:
- `options` (array of object): Priced delivery options, cheapest first. Empty — no method of the site delivers these items there (see `omitted`).
- `options[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `order/create`.
- `options[].name` (string): Delivery method name.
- `options[].type` (string): `courier` — to the door; `pick_up_point` — to a pick-up point: pass `pick_up_point_id` from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` to `order/create`.
- `options[].price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in `currency`. `courier` — the price of the order. `pick_up_point` with `pick_up_point_id` in the request — the price to that point (the order to it is charged the same); without it — the highest price among the points found for `city_id` (`price_is_upper_bound: true`): a particular point may be cheaper. `"0.00"` is a valid price.
- `options[].currency` (string): Price currency.
- `options[].price_is_upper_bound` (boolean): `true` — `price` is the highest price among the pick-up points of the city, not the price to a particular point.
- `options[].delivery_date` (string): Estimated delivery date as text in the primary language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display. The latest date over the warehouses of the items.
- `options[].delivery_date_iso` (string): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.
- `options[].weight_grams` (integer): Weight of all items the tariff priced, grams (unit weight of each product times its quantity).
- `options[].max_weight_grams` (integer or null): Maximum parcel weight of the method, grams; a heavier cart is omitted with `too_heavy`.
- `omitted` (array of object): Delivery methods enabled on the site that are not priced for this cart, with the reason: together with `options` they are all methods of the site.
- `omitted[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `omitted[].name` (string): Delivery method name.
- `omitted[].type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`.
- `omitted[].reason` (string: `city_required` | `no_pick_up_points` | `too_heavy` | `country_not_served` | `warehouse_not_served` | `city_not_served` | `not_priced`): Why the method is not priced: `city_required` — a pick-up method needs `city_id` (or `pick_up_point_id`); `no_pick_up_points` — no active pick-up point with a price in the city, its district or region; `too_heavy` — the cart is heavier than `max_weight_grams`; `country_not_served` — the tariff does not deliver to the country; `warehouse_not_served` — no tariff from the warehouse of an item (a cart from several warehouses needs a method that ships from all of them: split the cart); `city_not_served` — the site does not deliver to the city (Crimea, Sevastopol); `not_priced` — the tariff refused for another reason (an item it does not take, e.g. tyres).
- `omitted[].max_weight_grams` (integer or null): Maximum parcel weight of the method, grams; `null` when unknown.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/country-not-delivered`, `/api/problems/variation-unavailable`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List pick-up points

`POST /v2/delivery/pick-up-point/list` · `delivery_pick_up_point_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Active pick-up points of a pick-up delivery method in a settlement, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`; the same point model as `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. `city_id` is the KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`; points are taken in steps: the city, if it has none — its district, then its region (`city_id` of each point shows where it is). `min_latitude`, `min_longitude`, `max_latitude`, `max_longitude` narrow it to the frame of a map. With the cart (`product_variation_ids` and `quantities`, as `items` of `delivery/calculate`) each point of the page has `price` — what `order/create` with this `pick_up_point_id` charges for the delivery; without it `price` is `null`. Pass the chosen `id` as `pick_up_point_id` to `delivery/calculate` and `order/create`. A method that is not enabled on the site gives 422 `delivery-method-not-on-site`, a door method — 422 `pick-up-not-supported`, both with `pointer` `#/delivery_method_id`.

Body:
- `delivery_method_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Pick-up delivery method id (`with_pick_up_points` in `dictionary/delivery-method/list`, `type: pick_up_point` in `delivery/calculate`).
- `city_id` (string, required, pattern `^\d{11,19}$`): Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`, the same as `city_id` of `delivery/calculate` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`.
- `min_latitude` (number or null, -90..90): Map frame: south latitude. The frame filters only when all four bounds are passed.
- `min_longitude` (number or null, -180..180): Map frame: west longitude.
- `max_latitude` (number or null, -90..90): Map frame: north latitude.
- `max_longitude` (number or null, -180..180): Map frame: east longitude.
- `product_variation_ids` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item 1..2147483647): Cart to price the delivery to each point of the page, as `items` of `delivery/calculate`: product variation ids, quantities — in `quantities` at the same positions. Without it `price` is `null`.
- `quantities` (array of integer, items ≤ 100, item 1..1000): Quantities of `product_variation_ids` at the same positions, 1 to 1000; omitted — 1 of each.
- `currency` (string or null): Currency of `price`: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for Russia; by default the primary one.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Pick-up point id: pass it as `pick_up_point_id` to `order/create` and `delivery/calculate`.
- `name` (string or null): Name given by the delivery network, e.g. `MSK305, Москва, ул. Душинская`.
- `type` (string or null): `point` — regular pick-up point, `postamat` — parcel locker, `terminal` — terminal; `null` if the network did not report it.
- `courier` (string or null): Delivery network.
- `address` (string or null): Address.
- `schedule` (string or null): Opening hours as the network reports them.
- `phone` (string or null): Phone.
- `latitude` (number or null): Latitude.
- `longitude` (number or null): Longitude.
- `city_id` (string or null): KLADR id of the settlement of the point: may differ from `city_id` of the request when the city has no points (see the operation).
- `price` (string or null): Delivery price of the items of the request to the point, decimal string in `currency` — what `order/create` with this point charges; `null` without `product_variation_ids` or when the tariff does not price this point.
- `currency` (string or null): Currency of `price`; `null` when `price` is `null`.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/delivery-method-not-on-site`, `/api/problems/pick-up-not-supported`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/country-not-delivered`, `/api/problems/variation-unavailable`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Balance

The deposit of the site owner.

### List deposit operations

`POST /v2/balance/operation/list` · `balance_operation_list` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Operations of the deposit of the site owner, newest first, page by page (`meta.pager`): charges for orders paid with `order/pay`, refunds for orders, vouchers, top-ups and corrections by an operator. The amount is signed: a charge is negative. Canceling an order does not return the deposit: a refund is made by an operator and comes as `order_refund`. Filters: `currency`, `type`, `date_from` and `date_to` (days, inclusive).

Body:
- `currency` (string or null): Only operations in this currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR`.
- `type` (string: `order_charge` | `order_refund` | `voucher` | `adjustment` | `other` or null): Only operations of this type.
- `date_from` (string or null): Only operations made on this day or later, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `date_to` (string or null): Only operations made on this day or earlier, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size, 1 to 100, 50 by default.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Operation id.
- `type` (string: `order_charge` | `order_refund` | `voucher` | `adjustment` | `other`): `order_charge` — paid for an order (negative), `order_refund` — returned for an order (positive), `voucher` — a partner voucher, `adjustment` — a top-up or correction by an operator, `other` — other accruals (bonuses).
- `amount` (string): Signed amount, decimal string: negative — charged from the deposit, positive — added to it.
- `currency` (string): Currency of the amount: `RUB`, `USD`, `EUR`.
- `created_at` (string or null): When the operation was made; null for old operations without a date.
- `order_id` (integer or null): Order id (`order/show`) for `order_charge` and `order_refund`; null — not related to an order.
- `note` (string or null): Comment of the operator as written, often in Russian; null — none.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/forbidden`, `/api/problems/site-token-required`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show the deposit

`POST /v2/balance/show` · `balance_show` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Available deposit of the site owner in every deposit currency: the sum of the operations of `balance/operation/list` in that currency. The body is an empty object.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `currency` (string): Currency: `RUB`, `USD`, `EUR`.
- `amount` (string): Available amount, decimal string.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/forbidden`, `/api/problems/site-token-required`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Customer Auth

A customer of the site signs in (with the site token) and resets the password; the issued customer token opens the other customer groups.

### Confirm the sign-in or sign-up with the code

`POST /v2/customer-auth/confirm` · `customer_auth_confirm` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Exchanges `confirmation_id` and the code from the SMS or the email for the customer tokens. A new phone or email is registered. An email that is linked to an existing customer but not confirmed there (for example set by `customer-account/profile/update`) does not sign in to that customer: 422, sign in with its password or phone. A wrong code gives 401, too many wrong codes give 422, then 429 `sign-in-locked`.

Body:
- `confirmation_id` (string, required): `confirmation_id` from `customer-auth/sign-in` (`phone:123`) or `customer-auth/sign-up` (`email:` and 32 hex characters); the email one works only with the code of its own sign-up.
- `code` (string, required, length ≤ 16): Code from the SMS or the email.
- `guest_token` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Guest token of `customer-auth/guest`: the guest cart moves to the customer after the sign-in.

Response 200, `data`:
- `token` (string): Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: valid for `expires_in` seconds.
- `expires_in` (integer): Seconds the customer token is valid; then get a new one with `customer-auth/refresh`.
- `refresh_token` (string): One-time token for `customer-auth/refresh` and `customer-auth/sign-out`: keep it secret, on the server side of the site.
- `refresh_expires_in` (integer): Seconds the refresh token is valid; then the customer signs in again.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/sign-in-locked`, `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Get a guest token

`POST /v2/customer-auth/guest` · `customer_auth_guest` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

A token for a customer without an account (an app before sign-in): in `X-Customer-Auth-Token` it opens only `customer-cart/show` and `customer-cart/item/*`, other customer operations give 403 `customer-token-required`. The cart lives as long as the token, 90 days; renew it before with `guest_token`, the new token keeps the cart. To place an order the guest signs in or up with a code — `customer-auth/sign-in` by `phone` (SMS) or `customer-auth/sign-up` by `email` (the password is optional), then `customer-auth/confirm` with `guest_token`: the guest cart moves to the customer. A code is required because an order on an unconfirmed phone or email would show the order to the owner of that phone or email.

Body:
- `guest_token` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Current guest token to renew: the new token keeps its cart. Leave it out for a new guest with an empty cart.

Response 200, `data`:
- `token` (string): Guest token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: opens `customer-cart/show` and `customer-cart/item/*`, valid for `expires_in` seconds. Pass it as `guest_token` to `customer-auth/sign-in`, `sign-up` or `confirm` to keep the cart.
- `expires_in` (integer): Seconds the guest token is valid; renew it before with `customer-auth/guest` and the guest token.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Send a password reset link

`POST /v2/customer-auth/password/reset` · `customer_auth_password_reset` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Sends the customer an email with a link to set a new password. The answer is the same whether the email is registered or not, and when the mail service fails (the failure is logged). One request per email in a minute: an earlier one gives 422 on `email`.

Body:
- `email` (string, required): Customer email on the site.

Response 204, `data`:
- no fields

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Renew the customer token

`POST /v2/customer-auth/refresh` · `customer_auth_refresh` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Exchanges the refresh token for a new customer token and a new refresh token of the same sign-in. A refresh token works once: a second exchange of the same token (a replay or two parallel requests) gives 401 and ends the whole sign-in, both pairs stop working — sign the customer in again. It stops working after `customer-auth/sign-out`, a password change or reset, when the customer or the site token that issued it is disabled: 401, sign the customer in again.

Body:
- `refresh_token` (string, required, length ≤ 2000): `refresh_token` from `customer-auth/sign-in`, `customer-auth/confirm` or the previous `customer-auth/refresh`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `token` (string): Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: valid for `expires_in` seconds.
- `expires_in` (integer): Seconds the customer token is valid; then get a new one with `customer-auth/refresh`.
- `refresh_token` (string): One-time token for `customer-auth/refresh` and `customer-auth/sign-out`: keep it secret, on the server side of the site.
- `refresh_expires_in` (integer): Seconds the refresh token is valid; then the customer signs in again.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Sign a customer in

`POST /v2/customer-auth/sign-in` · `customer_auth_sign_in` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

By `phone` an SMS code is sent and `confirmation_id` is returned: finish with `customer-auth/confirm`. By `email` and `password` of a registered customer the tokens are returned at once; a new customer registers with `customer-auth/sign-up`. An unknown email, a disabled customer and a wrong password give the same 401. After 5 attempts for an email without a success within 15 minutes sign-in by it is locked: 429 `sign-in-locked` with `Retry-After`; after 300 failed sign-ins and codes through one site token within 15 minutes — for every customer of that token.

Body:
- `phone` (string or null, pattern `^(\+?\d{10,15})$`): Phone with the country code, digits only, e.g. `79001234567`: an SMS code is sent.
- `email` (string or null): Email of a registered customer of the site; a new customer registers with `customer-auth/sign-up`.
- `password` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Password for `email`.
- `guest_token` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Guest token of `customer-auth/guest`: with `email` and `password` the guest cart moves to the customer at once; with `phone` pass it to `customer-auth/confirm` instead.

Response 200, `data`:
- `token` (string or null): Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`; `null` — confirm the sign-in with the SMS code first.
- `expires_in` (integer or null): Seconds the customer token is valid; `null` with `confirmation_id`.
- `refresh_token` (string or null): One-time token for `customer-auth/refresh` and `customer-auth/sign-out`; `null` with `confirmation_id`.
- `refresh_expires_in` (integer or null): Seconds the refresh token is valid; `null` with `confirmation_id`.
- `confirmation_id` (string or null): Confirmation id for `customer-auth/confirm`; `null` when the tokens are issued at once.
- `code_length` (integer or null): Length of the SMS code.
- `code_lifetime` (integer or null): Seconds before a new code may be requested.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/sign-in-locked`, `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Sign a customer out

`POST /v2/customer-auth/sign-out` · `customer_auth_sign_out` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Ends the sign-in of the refresh token: its customer token and refresh token stop working at once. The answer is the same for an expired, already ended or unknown token.

Body:
- `refresh_token` (string, required, length ≤ 2000): `refresh_token` of the sign-in to end: its customer token stops working too.

Response 204, `data`:
- no fields

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Register a customer by email

`POST /v2/customer-auth/sign-up` · `customer_auth_sign_up` · token: site (`X-Auth-Token`)

Sends a code to the email and returns a one-time `confirmation_id` (`email:` and 32 hex characters): the customer is created with the password of this sign-up (or without a password, then they sign in by a code) by `customer-auth/confirm` with the code from the email. Every sign-up gets its own `confirmation_id`, and only it sets its password: another sign-up with the same email sends a new code but does not change the password of this one. The answer is the same whether the email is registered or not; for a registered email the code signs the customer in and the password stays as it was. A new code for the same email — not earlier than in a minute (422).

Body:
- `email` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Email of the new customer: the code to confirm it is sent there.
- `password` (string or null, length 6..255): Password for signing in by email after the confirmation; leave it out to register by the code only (a guest at checkout): the customer then signs in by a code or sets a password with `customer-auth/password/reset`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `confirmation_id` (string): Confirmation id for `customer-auth/confirm`, e.g. `email:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015`: one-time, a new `customer-auth/sign-up` gives a new one.
- `code_length` (integer): Length of the code in the email.
- `code_lifetime` (integer): Seconds before a new code may be requested.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/site-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Customer Account

The profile and the addresses of a customer.

### Add an address

`POST /v2/customer-account/address/create` · `customer_account_address_create` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Russian address: a settlement by `city_id` (KLADR) or `city_name`, street and house. Crimea and Sevastopol give 422.

Body:
- `address` (object, required): Address fields.
- `address.first_name` (string, required, length ≤ 100): Recipient first name.
- `address.last_name` (string, required, length ≤ 100): Recipient last name.
- `address.phone` (string, required, pattern `^(\+?\d{10,15})$`): Recipient phone with the country code, digits only.
- `address.street` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Street; outside Russia — the address line (street, house, building).
- `address.house` (string or null, length ≤ 32): House number; required in Russia.
- `address.country` (string or null): Country of the address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, one of the countries the site delivers to (`dictionary/country/list`); by default `RU`. The checkout delivers to this country and prices the cart for it.
- `address.city_id` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{11,19})$`): Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`, Russia only; in Russia `city_id` or `city_name` is required.
- `address.city_name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Settlement name, e.g. `Almaty`; required outside Russia, in Russia — for places without a KLADR id.
- `address.region` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Region (state, province) outside Russia, as text; in Russia it comes from KLADR.
- `address.flat` (string or null, length ≤ 32): Flat.
- `address.middle_name` (string or null, length ≤ 100): Recipient middle name.
- `address.email` (string or null): Recipient email; omitted — the email of the customer. The checkout skips addresses without an email.
- `address.note` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Note for the courier.
- `address.zip` (string or null, length ≤ 16): Postal code; omitted on update — stays as it is.

Response 201, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Address id: pass it as `address_id` to the checkout.
- `first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `phone` (string or null): Recipient phone, digits only.
- `email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.
- `region` (string or null): Region (state, province).
- `city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`; outside Russia — the name as passed.
- `city_id` (string or null): Settlement KLADR id (Russia); `null` outside Russia or for a settlement passed by name.
- `street` (string or null): Street.
- `house` (string or null): House.
- `flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `note` (string or null): Note for the courier.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Delete an address

`POST /v2/customer-account/address/delete` · `customer_account_address_delete` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Removes the address from the address book. An address of another customer gives 404.

Body:
- `address_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Address id.

Response 204, `data`:
- no fields

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List addresses

`POST /v2/customer-account/address/list` · `customer_account_address_list` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Addresses of the customer in the order they were added. Pass `id` as `address_id` to the checkout.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Address id: pass it as `address_id` to the checkout.
- `first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `phone` (string or null): Recipient phone, digits only.
- `email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.
- `region` (string or null): Region (state, province).
- `city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`; outside Russia — the name as passed.
- `city_id` (string or null): Settlement KLADR id (Russia); `null` outside Russia or for a settlement passed by name.
- `street` (string or null): Street.
- `house` (string or null): House.
- `flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `note` (string or null): Note for the courier.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update an address

`POST /v2/customer-account/address/update` · `customer_account_address_update` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Replaces all fields of the address. An address of another customer gives 404.

Body:
- `address_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Address id.
- `address` (object, required): Address fields.
- `address.first_name` (string, required, length ≤ 100): Recipient first name.
- `address.last_name` (string, required, length ≤ 100): Recipient last name.
- `address.phone` (string, required, pattern `^(\+?\d{10,15})$`): Recipient phone with the country code, digits only.
- `address.street` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Street; outside Russia — the address line (street, house, building).
- `address.house` (string or null, length ≤ 32): House number; required in Russia.
- `address.country` (string or null): Country of the address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, one of the countries the site delivers to (`dictionary/country/list`); by default `RU`. The checkout delivers to this country and prices the cart for it.
- `address.city_id` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{11,19})$`): Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`, Russia only; in Russia `city_id` or `city_name` is required.
- `address.city_name` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Settlement name, e.g. `Almaty`; required outside Russia, in Russia — for places without a KLADR id.
- `address.region` (string or null, length ≤ 255): Region (state, province) outside Russia, as text; in Russia it comes from KLADR.
- `address.flat` (string or null, length ≤ 32): Flat.
- `address.middle_name` (string or null, length ≤ 100): Recipient middle name.
- `address.email` (string or null): Recipient email; omitted — the email of the customer. The checkout skips addresses without an email.
- `address.note` (string or null, length ≤ 1000): Note for the courier.
- `address.zip` (string or null, length ≤ 16): Postal code; omitted on update — stays as it is.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Address id: pass it as `address_id` to the checkout.
- `first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `phone` (string or null): Recipient phone, digits only.
- `email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.
- `region` (string or null): Region (state, province).
- `city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`; outside Russia — the name as passed.
- `city_id` (string or null): Settlement KLADR id (Russia); `null` outside Russia or for a settlement passed by name.
- `street` (string or null): Street.
- `house` (string or null): House.
- `flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `note` (string or null): Note for the courier.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Change the password

`POST /v2/customer-account/password/update` · `customer_account_password_update` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Sets a new password when `old_password` is right. All customer tokens and refresh tokens of the customer stop working, this one too: the answer has new tokens. A wrong `old_password` gives 422; after 5 wrong ones within 15 minutes — 429 `sign-in-locked`.

Body:
- `old_password` (string, required, length ≤ 255): Current password of the customer.
- `new_password` (string, required, length 6..255): New password.

Response 200, `data`:
- `token` (string): Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: valid for `expires_in` seconds.
- `expires_in` (integer): Seconds the customer token is valid; then get a new one with `customer-auth/refresh`.
- `refresh_token` (string): One-time token for `customer-auth/refresh` and `customer-auth/sign-out`: keep it secret, on the server side of the site.
- `refresh_expires_in` (integer): Seconds the refresh token is valid; then the customer signs in again.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/sign-in-locked`, `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Delete the account

`POST /v2/customer-account/profile/delete` · `customer_account_profile_delete` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Deletes the account of the customer of the token, as app stores require: the phone and the email are removed and become free for a new registration, the customer is disabled and every customer token and refresh token stops working at once. Orders stay with the store for delivery and accounting. Pass `confirm: true`; it cannot be undone.

Body:
- `confirm` (boolean): Must be `true`: the deletion cannot be undone, the flag guards against an accidental call.

Response 204, `data`:
- no fields

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show the profile

`POST /v2/customer-account/profile/show` · `customer_account_profile_show` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Profile of the customer of the token with the city and the default address used by the checkout.

Body:
- none, send `{}`

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Customer id.
- `name` (string or null): Full name as stored: last, first and middle name.
- `first_name` (string or null): First name: the second word of `name`.
- `last_name` (string or null): Last name: the first word of `name`.
- `middle_name` (string or null): Middle name: the third word of `name`.
- `email` (string or null): Email.
- `phone` (string or null): Phone, digits only.
- `email_confirmed` (boolean): Whether the email is confirmed.
- `phone_confirmed` (boolean): Whether the phone is confirmed.
- `birth_date` (string or null): Birth date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `gender` (string or null): Gender as entered.
- `city_id` (string or null): City (KLADR id) used for delivery options when no address is chosen.
- `default_address_id` (integer or null): Default address from the address book.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update the profile

`POST /v2/customer-account/profile/update` · `customer_account_profile_update` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Name, birth date, gender, city and default address. An email can only be added when the customer has none and it is free on the site (the confirmation email is sent in the background); changing an existing email gives 422. The password is changed with `customer-account/password/update`.

Body:
- `first_name` (string or null, length ≤ 100): First name; omitted — stays as it is.
- `last_name` (string or null, length ≤ 100): Last name; omitted — stays as it is.
- `middle_name` (string or null, length ≤ 100): Middle name; omitted — stays as it is, empty string — removed.
- `email` (string or null): Email: only set if the customer has none; changing an existing email is refused.
- `birth_date` (string or null): Birth date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; omitted — stays as it is, empty string — removed.
- `gender` (string: `male` | `female` | `` or null): Gender: `male` or `female`; omitted — stays as it is, empty string — removed.
- `city_id` (string or null, pattern `^(\d{11,19})$`): City (KLADR id) from `dictionary/city/search`: delivery options without a chosen address are for this city.
- `default_address_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Default address id from `customer-account/address/list`; an address of another customer gives 404.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Customer id.
- `name` (string or null): Full name as stored: last, first and middle name.
- `first_name` (string or null): First name: the second word of `name`.
- `last_name` (string or null): Last name: the first word of `name`.
- `middle_name` (string or null): Middle name: the third word of `name`.
- `email` (string or null): Email.
- `phone` (string or null): Phone, digits only.
- `email_confirmed` (boolean): Whether the email is confirmed.
- `phone_confirmed` (boolean): Whether the phone is confirmed.
- `birth_date` (string or null): Birth date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `gender` (string or null): Gender as entered.
- `city_id` (string or null): City (KLADR id) used for delivery options when no address is chosen.
- `default_address_id` (integer or null): Default address from the address book.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Customer Cart

The cart and the checkout of a customer: items, delivery options, pick-up points.

### Show the checkout

`POST /v2/customer-cart/checkout/show` · `customer_cart_checkout_show` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Selected cart items split into packages by warehouse with delivery methods, payment methods, the chosen address and totals. Prices and delivery are for the country of the chosen address. A package with a pick-up method gets no point silently: until `pick_up_point_id` is chosen it is `available: false` (`pick_up_point_required`) and `deliverable` is false. An empty cart gives 422.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Checkout id (the cart id).
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `address_id` (integer or null): Chosen address id from the address book; its country is the country of delivery and of the prices.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages: selected cart items split by warehouse.
- `packages[].id` (string): Package id: pass it as `package_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update` and `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. It changes with the items of the cart: take it from the latest checkout.
- `packages[].warehouse_country` (string): Country of the warehouse the package is shipped from, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case, as `warehouse_country` in `stock/*`.
- `packages[].destination_country` (string): Country of delivery, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: the country of the chosen address, otherwise the country of the request.
- `packages[].available` (boolean): `true` — the package can be ordered: a delivery method is chosen, its pick-up point is chosen when the method needs one, the items are in stock.
- `packages[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_delivery_method` | `pick_up_point_required` | `out_of_stock` or null): Why the package cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_delivery_method` — no method delivers it to the address; `pick_up_point_required` — pass `pick_up_point_id` from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`; `out_of_stock` — lower the quantity of an item to its `available_quantity`.
- `packages[].items_price` (string): Price of the items, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_price` (string): Delivery price of the chosen method, decimal string.
- `packages[].duty_price` (string): Customs duty, decimal string.
- `packages[].total` (string): Total of the package, decimal string.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].cart_item_id` (integer): Cart item id.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_options` (array of object): Delivery methods of the package; the chosen one has `selected: true`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].name` (string): Name.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].selected` (boolean): Chosen for the package.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date` (string or null): Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date_iso` (string or null): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer or null): Chosen delivery method id, `null` — none.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point chosen by the customer for a pick-up method; `null` — none chosen (the checkout does not pick one silently).
- `payment_methods` (array of object): Payment methods: pass `id` as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].id` (string): Payment method id: pass it as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].name` (string): Name.
- `payment_methods[].selected` (boolean): Chosen.
- `total` (string): Total of all packages after the promo code discount, decimal string: the amount `customer-order/create` charges.
- `deliverable` (boolean): `true` — every package is `available` (delivery method chosen, its pick-up point chosen, items in stock): `customer-order/create` is possible once an address is chosen (`address_id`). `false` — see `unavailable_reason` of the packages; no packages at all — nothing can be delivered to the address (`undeliverable_cart_item_ids`).
- `undeliverable_cart_item_ids` (array of integer): Selected cart items left out of the packages: no delivery method of the site takes them to the address (country, warehouse, weight) or they cannot be bought now. They are not ordered; remove them or unselect them in `customer-cart/item/update`, or choose another address.
- `promo_code` (string or null): Applied promo code (`customer-cart/promo-code/apply`); `null` — none.
- `promo_discount` (string): Promo code discount on items and delivery, decimal string, already subtracted from `total`; `0.00` without a code.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Save the checkout choice

`POST /v2/customer-cart/checkout/update` · `customer_cart_checkout_update` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Saves the address, payment method and the delivery method (with the pick-up point) of one package; omitted fields stay. Every value is checked against the current checkout: an unknown package — 404 on `package_id`; a method the package does not have — 422 on `delivery_method_id`; a point not in `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list` of the method or a point for a courier method — 422 on `pick_up_point_id`; a payment method not in `payment_methods` — 422 on `payment_method_id`; an address of another customer — 404 on `address_id`. The address is saved first: packages and methods depend on it. The order notifications go to the email of the address (the email of the customer if the address has none): change it with `customer-account/address/update`. Returns the recalculated checkout.

Body:
- `address_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Address id from `customer-account/address/list`; its country becomes the country of delivery and of the prices. Saved first: packages, delivery methods and payment methods depend on it. An address of another customer gives 404.
- `payment_method_id` (string or null, length ≤ 64): Payment method id from `payment_methods` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`; another id gives 422.
- `package_id` (string or null, length ≤ 64): Package id from `packages` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`; required with `delivery_method_id`. An unknown id gives 404 (the id changes with the items of the cart).
- `delivery_method_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Delivery method id from `delivery_options` of the package; required with `package_id` and `pick_up_point_id`. A method the package does not have gives 422.
- `pick_up_point_id` (integer or null, 1..2147483647): Pick-up point id from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list` of the same package and method; only for a method with `type: pick_up_point`. A point of another method or city gives 422. Without it a pick-up method stays without a point: the package is `available: false` (`pick_up_point_required`) until a point is chosen.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Checkout id (the cart id).
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `address_id` (integer or null): Chosen address id from the address book; its country is the country of delivery and of the prices.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages: selected cart items split by warehouse.
- `packages[].id` (string): Package id: pass it as `package_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update` and `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. It changes with the items of the cart: take it from the latest checkout.
- `packages[].warehouse_country` (string): Country of the warehouse the package is shipped from, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case, as `warehouse_country` in `stock/*`.
- `packages[].destination_country` (string): Country of delivery, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: the country of the chosen address, otherwise the country of the request.
- `packages[].available` (boolean): `true` — the package can be ordered: a delivery method is chosen, its pick-up point is chosen when the method needs one, the items are in stock.
- `packages[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_delivery_method` | `pick_up_point_required` | `out_of_stock` or null): Why the package cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_delivery_method` — no method delivers it to the address; `pick_up_point_required` — pass `pick_up_point_id` from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`; `out_of_stock` — lower the quantity of an item to its `available_quantity`.
- `packages[].items_price` (string): Price of the items, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_price` (string): Delivery price of the chosen method, decimal string.
- `packages[].duty_price` (string): Customs duty, decimal string.
- `packages[].total` (string): Total of the package, decimal string.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].cart_item_id` (integer): Cart item id.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_options` (array of object): Delivery methods of the package; the chosen one has `selected: true`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].name` (string): Name.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].selected` (boolean): Chosen for the package.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date` (string or null): Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date_iso` (string or null): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer or null): Chosen delivery method id, `null` — none.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point chosen by the customer for a pick-up method; `null` — none chosen (the checkout does not pick one silently).
- `payment_methods` (array of object): Payment methods: pass `id` as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].id` (string): Payment method id: pass it as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].name` (string): Name.
- `payment_methods[].selected` (boolean): Chosen.
- `total` (string): Total of all packages after the promo code discount, decimal string: the amount `customer-order/create` charges.
- `deliverable` (boolean): `true` — every package is `available` (delivery method chosen, its pick-up point chosen, items in stock): `customer-order/create` is possible once an address is chosen (`address_id`). `false` — see `unavailable_reason` of the packages; no packages at all — nothing can be delivered to the address (`undeliverable_cart_item_ids`).
- `undeliverable_cart_item_ids` (array of integer): Selected cart items left out of the packages: no delivery method of the site takes them to the address (country, warehouse, weight) or they cannot be bought now. They are not ordered; remove them or unselect them in `customer-cart/item/update`, or choose another address.
- `promo_code` (string or null): Applied promo code (`customer-cart/promo-code/apply`); `null` — none.
- `promo_discount` (string): Promo code discount on items and delivery, decimal string, already subtracted from `total`; `0.00` without a code.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List delivery options

`POST /v2/customer-cart/delivery-option/list` · `customer_cart_delivery_option_list` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

With `package_id` — methods of that checkout package with prices for the chosen address: the same as `delivery_options` of the package in `customer-cart/checkout/show`, choose one there. Without `package_id` — a preview before the checkout: methods for all items of the cart as one shipment to the city of the profile or of the default address (Russia without a city gives 422); the checkout may split the cart into packages by warehouse with their own methods. `delivery_date` is text for display, `delivery_date_iso` — the same date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

Body:
- `package_id` (string or null, length ≤ 64): Package id from the checkout; without it — for the whole cart to the city of the profile or the default address.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `name` (string): Name.
- `type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.
- `price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.
- `selected` (boolean): Chosen for the package.
- `delivery_date` (string or null): Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.
- `delivery_date_iso` (string or null): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Add an item to the cart

`POST /v2/customer-cart/item/create` · `customer_cart_item_create` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Puts the variation into the cart with the given quantity; the cart is created with the first item, the cart takes the best offer of the site itself. A variation not sold on the site, without stock or not delivered by the tariff of the site gives 422 with `pointer` on `product_variation_id`; a quantity above the stock gives 422 on `quantity` with the stock in `detail`.

Body:
- `product_variation_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Product variation id from `variations[].id` of `stock/product/show` (or `stock/list`); a variation without stock gives 422.
- `quantity` (integer, 1..1000): Quantity to set for the variation (not added to the quantity already in the cart); more than the stock gives 422 with the stock in `detail`.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer or null): Cart id, it is also the checkout id; `null` — the cart is not created yet.
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `items` (array of object): Items in the order they were added. Items without an offer are removed when the cart is read.
- `items[].id` (integer): Cart item id: the key of `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-cart/item/delete`.
- `items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `items[].offer_id` (integer or null): Offer id the item is bought from (warehouse of the variation chosen by the cart); for support requests.
- `items[].name` (string or null): Product name in the language of `site_variation`, the same as `name` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].variation` (string or null): Variation parameters as text, e.g. `Size: M`; `null` — the product has no variation parameters.
- `items[].image` (string or null): Image URL.
- `items[].url` (string or null): Absolute URL of the product page on the storefront of `site_variation`, as `url` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the cart currency, decimal string.
- `items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `items[].available_quantity` (integer): Units in stock that can be ordered now, as `quantity` of the variation in `stock/list`; `quantity` above it gives 422 in `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-order/create`.
- `items[].selected` (boolean): Selected for the checkout.
- `selected_quantity` (integer): Units selected for the checkout.
- `selected_price` (string): Price of the selected units, decimal string; delivery is calculated at the checkout.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Remove items from the cart

`POST /v2/customer-cart/item/delete` · `customer_cart_item_delete` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Removes the items; if any of them is not in the cart nothing is removed and 404 is returned.

Body:
- `item_ids` (array of integer, required, items 1..100, item ≤ 2147483647): Cart item ids.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer or null): Cart id, it is also the checkout id; `null` — the cart is not created yet.
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `items` (array of object): Items in the order they were added. Items without an offer are removed when the cart is read.
- `items[].id` (integer): Cart item id: the key of `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-cart/item/delete`.
- `items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `items[].offer_id` (integer or null): Offer id the item is bought from (warehouse of the variation chosen by the cart); for support requests.
- `items[].name` (string or null): Product name in the language of `site_variation`, the same as `name` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].variation` (string or null): Variation parameters as text, e.g. `Size: M`; `null` — the product has no variation parameters.
- `items[].image` (string or null): Image URL.
- `items[].url` (string or null): Absolute URL of the product page on the storefront of `site_variation`, as `url` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the cart currency, decimal string.
- `items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `items[].available_quantity` (integer): Units in stock that can be ordered now, as `quantity` of the variation in `stock/list`; `quantity` above it gives 422 in `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-order/create`.
- `items[].selected` (boolean): Selected for the checkout.
- `selected_quantity` (integer): Units selected for the checkout.
- `selected_price` (string): Price of the selected units, decimal string; delivery is calculated at the checkout.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Update a cart item

`POST /v2/customer-cart/item/update` · `customer_cart_item_update` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Quantity and selection for the checkout; omitted fields stay. A quantity above the stock gives 422 on `quantity` with the stock in `detail` (it is not cut silently). An item of another cart gives 404.

Body:
- `item_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Cart item id.
- `quantity` (integer or null, 1..1000): New quantity; more than `available_quantity` of the item gives 422 with the stock, the quantity is not cut silently.
- `selected` (boolean or null): Select for the checkout or exclude from it; the item stays in the cart.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer or null): Cart id, it is also the checkout id; `null` — the cart is not created yet.
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `items` (array of object): Items in the order they were added. Items without an offer are removed when the cart is read.
- `items[].id` (integer): Cart item id: the key of `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-cart/item/delete`.
- `items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `items[].offer_id` (integer or null): Offer id the item is bought from (warehouse of the variation chosen by the cart); for support requests.
- `items[].name` (string or null): Product name in the language of `site_variation`, the same as `name` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].variation` (string or null): Variation parameters as text, e.g. `Size: M`; `null` — the product has no variation parameters.
- `items[].image` (string or null): Image URL.
- `items[].url` (string or null): Absolute URL of the product page on the storefront of `site_variation`, as `url` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the cart currency, decimal string.
- `items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `items[].available_quantity` (integer): Units in stock that can be ordered now, as `quantity` of the variation in `stock/list`; `quantity` above it gives 422 in `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-order/create`.
- `items[].selected` (boolean): Selected for the checkout.
- `selected_quantity` (integer): Units selected for the checkout.
- `selected_price` (string): Price of the selected units, decimal string; delivery is calculated at the checkout.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List pick-up points

`POST /v2/customer-cart/pick-up-point/list` · `customer_cart_pick_up_point_list` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Pick-up points of a pick-up delivery method (`type: pick_up_point`) of the checkout package with the delivery price, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`. Only points of one settlement: `city_id`, by default the settlement of the chosen address (an address without a KLADR id — points whose address has its city); `min_latitude`, `min_longitude`, `max_latitude`, `max_longitude` narrow it to the frame of a map. A courier method gives 422. Pass the chosen `id` (integer) as `pick_up_point_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`: no point is chosen silently, `selected: true` is the point the customer chose.

Body:
- `package_id` (string, required, length ≤ 64): Package id from `packages` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `delivery_method_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Pick-up delivery method id of the package (`type: pick_up_point` in `delivery_options`); a courier method gives 422.
- `city_id` (string or null, pattern `^\d{11,19}$`): Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`: only points of this settlement. By default — the settlement of the chosen address, or points whose address has the city of the chosen address when it has no KLADR id.
- `min_latitude` (number or null, -90..90): Map frame: south latitude. The frame filters only when all four bounds are passed.
- `min_longitude` (number or null, -180..180): Map frame: west longitude.
- `max_latitude` (number or null, -90..90): Map frame: north latitude.
- `max_longitude` (number or null, -180..180): Map frame: east longitude.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Pick-up point id: pass it as `pick_up_point_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`; the same integer as `pick_up_point_id` of the checkout package.
- `courier` (string or null): Delivery network.
- `address` (string or null): Address.
- `schedule` (string or null): Opening hours.
- `phone` (string or null): Phone.
- `latitude` (number or null): Latitude.
- `longitude` (number or null): Longitude.
- `price` (string): Delivery price to the point, decimal string.
- `selected` (boolean): Chosen by the customer for the package (`pick_up_point_id` of the package); no point is chosen silently.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Apply a promo code

`POST /v2/customer-cart/promo-code/apply` · `customer_cart_promo_code_apply` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Applies a promo code of the site to the checkout, as the promo code field of the storefront cart: `promo_code` and `promo_discount` of the returned checkout show it, `total` is already discounted and `customer-order/create` charges the same. A code that is unknown, inactive, expired or whose conditions the cart does not meet (minimum amount, first order, brands, rubrics, single use and so on) gives 422 on `code` naming the failed conditions; the checkout stays without it. A new code replaces the applied one.

Body:
- `code` (string, required, length ≤ 100): Promo code of the site, case does not matter.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Checkout id (the cart id).
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `address_id` (integer or null): Chosen address id from the address book; its country is the country of delivery and of the prices.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages: selected cart items split by warehouse.
- `packages[].id` (string): Package id: pass it as `package_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update` and `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. It changes with the items of the cart: take it from the latest checkout.
- `packages[].warehouse_country` (string): Country of the warehouse the package is shipped from, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case, as `warehouse_country` in `stock/*`.
- `packages[].destination_country` (string): Country of delivery, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: the country of the chosen address, otherwise the country of the request.
- `packages[].available` (boolean): `true` — the package can be ordered: a delivery method is chosen, its pick-up point is chosen when the method needs one, the items are in stock.
- `packages[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_delivery_method` | `pick_up_point_required` | `out_of_stock` or null): Why the package cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_delivery_method` — no method delivers it to the address; `pick_up_point_required` — pass `pick_up_point_id` from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`; `out_of_stock` — lower the quantity of an item to its `available_quantity`.
- `packages[].items_price` (string): Price of the items, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_price` (string): Delivery price of the chosen method, decimal string.
- `packages[].duty_price` (string): Customs duty, decimal string.
- `packages[].total` (string): Total of the package, decimal string.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].cart_item_id` (integer): Cart item id.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_options` (array of object): Delivery methods of the package; the chosen one has `selected: true`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].name` (string): Name.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].selected` (boolean): Chosen for the package.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date` (string or null): Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date_iso` (string or null): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer or null): Chosen delivery method id, `null` — none.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point chosen by the customer for a pick-up method; `null` — none chosen (the checkout does not pick one silently).
- `payment_methods` (array of object): Payment methods: pass `id` as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].id` (string): Payment method id: pass it as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].name` (string): Name.
- `payment_methods[].selected` (boolean): Chosen.
- `total` (string): Total of all packages after the promo code discount, decimal string: the amount `customer-order/create` charges.
- `deliverable` (boolean): `true` — every package is `available` (delivery method chosen, its pick-up point chosen, items in stock): `customer-order/create` is possible once an address is chosen (`address_id`). `false` — see `unavailable_reason` of the packages; no packages at all — nothing can be delivered to the address (`undeliverable_cart_item_ids`).
- `undeliverable_cart_item_ids` (array of integer): Selected cart items left out of the packages: no delivery method of the site takes them to the address (country, warehouse, weight) or they cannot be bought now. They are not ordered; remove them or unselect them in `customer-cart/item/update`, or choose another address.
- `promo_code` (string or null): Applied promo code (`customer-cart/promo-code/apply`); `null` — none.
- `promo_discount` (string): Promo code discount on items and delivery, decimal string, already subtracted from `total`; `0.00` without a code.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`, `/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Remove the promo code

`POST /v2/customer-cart/promo-code/delete` · `customer_cart_promo_code_delete` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Removes the applied promo code from the checkout; without a code nothing changes. Returns the recalculated checkout.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Checkout id (the cart id).
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `address_id` (integer or null): Chosen address id from the address book; its country is the country of delivery and of the prices.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages: selected cart items split by warehouse.

- `packages[].destination_country` (string): Country of delivery, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: the country of the chosen address, otherwise the country of the request.
- `packages[].available` (boolean): `true` — the package can be ordered: a delivery method is chosen, its pick-up point is chosen when the method needs one, the items are in stock.
- `packages[].unavailable_reason` (string: `no_delivery_method` | `pick_up_point_required` | `out_of_stock` or null): Why the package cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_delivery_method` — no method delivers it to the address; `pick_up_point_required` — pass `pick_up_point_id` from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`; `out_of_stock` — lower the quantity of an item to its `available_quantity`.
- `packages[].items_price` (string): Price of the items, decimal string.
- `packages[].delivery_price` (string): Delivery price of the chosen method, decimal string.
- `packages[].duty_price` (string): Customs duty, decimal string.

- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.

- `packages[].delivery_options` (array of object): Delivery methods of the package; the chosen one has `selected: true`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].name` (string): Name.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].type` (string): `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].selected` (boolean): Chosen for the package.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date` (string or null): Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.
- `packages[].delivery_options[].delivery_date_iso` (string or null): Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer or null): Chosen delivery method id, `null` — none.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point chosen by the customer for a pick-up method; `null` — none chosen (the checkout does not pick one silently).
- `payment_methods` (array of object): Payment methods: pass `id` as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].id` (string): Payment method id: pass it as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- `payment_methods[].name` (string): Name.
- `payment_methods[].selected` (boolean): Chosen.
- `total` (string): Total of all packages after the promo code discount, decimal string: the amount `customer-order/create` charges.
- `deliverable` (boolean): `true` — every package is `available` (delivery method chosen, its pick-up point chosen, items in stock): `customer-order/create` is possible once an address is chosen (`address_id`). `false` — see `unavailable_reason` of the packages; no packages at all — nothing can be delivered to the address (`undeliverable_cart_item_ids`).
- `undeliverable_cart_item_ids` (array of integer): Selected cart items left out of the packages: no delivery method of the site takes them to the address (country, warehouse, weight) or they cannot be bought now. They are not ordered; remove them or unselect them in `customer-cart/item/update`, or choose another address.
- `promo_code` (string or null): Applied promo code (`customer-cart/promo-code/apply`); `null` — none.
- `promo_discount` (string): Promo code discount on items and delivery, decimal string, already subtracted from `total`; `0.00` without a code.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
