- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show the cart

`POST /v2/customer-cart/show` · `customer_cart_show` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Items with current prices: items without an offer are removed, prices are updated. Name and `url` of an item are those of `stock/product/show` for the same `site_variation`; `available_quantity` — the stock that can be ordered now. When an address is chosen in the checkout, prices are for its country. An empty cart is not an error.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer or null): Cart id, it is also the checkout id; `null` — the cart is not created yet.
- `currency` (string): Currency of prices.
- `items` (array of object): Items in the order they were added. Items without an offer are removed when the cart is read.
- `items[].id` (integer): Cart item id: the key of `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-cart/item/delete`.
- `items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `items[].offer_id` (integer or null): Offer id the item is bought from (warehouse of the variation chosen by the cart); for support requests.
- `items[].name` (string or null): Product name in the language of `site_variation`, the same as `name` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].variation` (string or null): Variation parameters as text, e.g. `Size: M`; `null` — the product has no variation parameters.
- `items[].image` (string or null): Image URL.
- `items[].url` (string or null): Absolute URL of the product page on the storefront of `site_variation`, as `url` of `stock/product/show`.
- `items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the cart currency, decimal string.
- `items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `items[].available_quantity` (integer): Units in stock that can be ordered now, as `quantity` of the variation in `stock/list`; `quantity` above it gives 422 in `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-order/create`.
- `items[].selected` (boolean): Selected for the checkout.
- `selected_quantity` (integer): Units selected for the checkout.
- `selected_price` (string): Price of the selected units, decimal string; delivery is calculated at the checkout.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

## Customer Order

Orders of a customer: place from the cart, list, show the card with delivery and the payment link, cancel.

### Cancel my order

`POST /v2/customer-order/cancel` · `customer_order_cancel` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Cancels an unpaid order of the customer, as the cancel button of the account on the site: all items are canceled, the order becomes `canceled`, `total_price` and `delivery_price` become `0.00`, `payment_url` becomes `null`. Returns the card of `customer-order/show`. A paid order is canceled and refunded only by the shop: 409 `/api/problems/order-already-paid`. Canceling a canceled order changes nothing and returns it (200). An order of another customer gives 404.

Body:
- `order_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Order id (O), from `customer-order/list` or `customer-order/create`.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the names in the response; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency.
- `total_price` (string): Total of the active items including delivery, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `delivery_price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid. There is no notification about the payment: poll `customer-order/show`.
- `payment_url` (string or null): Payment page of the site while the order is not paid and not canceled, otherwise `null`: the customer picks the payment method there. The link does not expire: open it again to retry a failed payment. After the bank the customer goes to `return_url` of `customer-order/create` (kept 30 days), without it stays on the site.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system of the payment, before it — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — none chosen.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `status_history` (array of object): Status changes from the oldest: the order entered `status` at `at`. The history may lag behind `status` by a few minutes; empty when it is not recorded yet or temporarily unavailable.
- `status_history[].status` (string): Order status entered, the values of `status`.
- `status_history[].at` (string): When the order entered the status.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with delivery and items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].delivery_method` (string): Delivery method name in the language of `site_variation`.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_address` (string or null): Address of the pick-up point, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient; `null` — the package has no address.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form for the recipient; `null` — no passport is needed now.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].items[].image` (string or null): Product image saved with the order, absolute URL; `null` — the product had no image.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 409: `/api/problems/order-already-paid`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Place the order

`POST /v2/customer-order/create` · `customer_order_create` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Creates the order from the selected cart items with the saved checkout choice (`customer-cart/checkout/update`) and returns `payment_url`: the payment page of the site for the chosen payment method. Open it for the customer; after the bank the payment page of the site sends the customer to `return_url` (with `order_id` and `payment_status`), without it the customer stays on the site. There is no notification: poll `is_paid` of `customer-order/show`. A failed or abandoned payment is repeated with `payment_url` of `customer-order/show`. No address, a package without delivery, a pick-up point not chosen (`pick-up-point-required`) or an item over its stock give 422.

Body:
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.
- `country` (string or null): Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.
- `currency` (string or null): Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.
- `locale` (string or null, length 2..5): Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.
- `return_url` (string or null, length ≤ 2000): Where the payment page sends the customer after the bank: a deep link of the app (`myapp://orders`) or an `https` page. `order_id` and `payment_status` (`paid`, `pending` — the bank accepted it, the confirmation is on its way, poll `customer-order/show`; `failed`) are added to its query. Without it the customer stays on the payment page of the site.

Response 201, `data`:
- `order_id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `payment_url` (string): Payment page of the site for the chosen payment method.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/business-rule`, `/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`, `/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### List my orders

`POST /v2/customer-order/list` · `customer_order_list` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

Orders of the customer on the site, newest first, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`. Each order is the card of `customer-order/show`: delivery, address and recipient of the packages, payment method, `payment_url` of an unpaid order, item images, `status_history`. `status` filters by one status; an unknown status gives 422. Names of delivery and payment methods are in the language of `site_variation`.

Body:
- `status` (string: `new` | `confirmed` | `wait_in_store` | `in_store` | `packed` | `sent` | `delivered` | `canceled` or null): Only orders in this status; all statuses if omitted.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the names of delivery and payment methods; the default variation if omitted.
- `page` (integer, 1..2147483647, default 1): Page number, from 1.
- `per_page` (integer, 1..100, default 50): Page size.

Response 200, `data` (array of objects):
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency.
- `total_price` (string): Total of the active items including delivery, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `delivery_price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid. There is no notification about the payment: poll `customer-order/show`.
- `payment_url` (string or null): Payment page of the site while the order is not paid and not canceled, otherwise `null`: the customer picks the payment method there. The link does not expire: open it again to retry a failed payment. After the bank the customer goes to `return_url` of `customer-order/create` (kept 30 days), without it stays on the site.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system of the payment, before it — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — none chosen.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `status_history` (array of object): Status changes from the oldest: the order entered `status` at `at`. The history may lag behind `status` by a few minutes; empty when it is not recorded yet or temporarily unavailable.
- `status_history[].status` (string): Order status entered, the values of `status`.
- `status_history[].at` (string): When the order entered the status.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with delivery and items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].delivery_method` (string): Delivery method name in the language of `site_variation`.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_address` (string or null): Address of the pick-up point, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient; `null` — the package has no address.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form for the recipient; `null` — no passport is needed now.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].items[].image` (string or null): Product image saved with the order, absolute URL; `null` — the product had no image.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`

### Show my order

`POST /v2/customer-order/show` · `customer_order_show` · token: customer (`X-Customer-Auth-Token`)

The card of an order of the customer, as the order page of the account on the site: totals, `is_paid` and `payment_url` (the payment page of the site while the order is unpaid and not canceled; open it again to repeat a failed payment), payment method, packages with delivery method, pick-up point address, delivery address and recipient, items with images, and `status_history` — when the order entered each status. There is no notification about the payment or a status change: poll this operation. An order of another customer gives 404.

Body:
- `order_id` (integer, required, 1..2147483647): Order id (O), from `customer-order/list` or `customer-order/create`.
- `site_variation` (string or null, length ≤ 50): Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the names of delivery and payment methods; the default variation if omitted.

Response 200, `data`:
- `id` (integer): Order id (O).
- `status` (string): Order status: `new`, `confirmed`, `wait_in_store`, `in_store`, `packed`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `created_at` (string): Creation time.
- `currency` (string): Order currency.
- `total_price` (string): Total of the active items including delivery, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `delivery_price` (string): Delivery price, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.
- `is_paid` (boolean): Whether the order is paid. There is no notification about the payment: poll `customer-order/show`.
- `payment_url` (string or null): Payment page of the site while the order is not paid and not canceled, otherwise `null`: the customer picks the payment method there. The link does not expire: open it again to retry a failed payment. After the bank the customer goes to `return_url` of `customer-order/create` (kept 30 days), without it stays on the site.
- `payment_method` (object): Payment method: the payment system of the payment, before it — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — none chosen.
- `payment_method.id` (string): Payment method id, as `payment_methods[].id` of `customer-cart/checkout/show`.
- `payment_method.name` (string): Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.
- `status_history` (array of object): Status changes from the oldest: the order entered `status` at `at`. The history may lag behind `status` by a few minutes; empty when it is not recorded yet or temporarily unavailable.
- `status_history[].status` (string): Order status entered, the values of `status`.
- `status_history[].at` (string): When the order entered the status.
- `packages` (array of object): Packages with delivery and items.
- `packages[].id` (integer): Package id (P).
- `packages[].status` (string or null): Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.
- `packages[].tracking` (string or null): Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.
- `packages[].delivery_method_id` (integer): Delivery method id.
- `packages[].delivery_method` (string): Delivery method name in the language of `site_variation`.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_id` (integer or null): Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].pick_up_point_address` (string or null): Address of the pick-up point, `null` for courier delivery.
- `packages[].address` (object): Delivery address and recipient; `null` — the package has no address.
- `packages[].address.first_name` (string or null): Recipient first name.
- `packages[].address.last_name` (string or null): Recipient last name.
- `packages[].address.middle_name` (string or null): Recipient middle name.
- `packages[].address.phone` (string or null): Recipient phone.
- `packages[].address.email` (string or null): Recipient email.
- `packages[].address.country` (string or null): Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.
- `packages[].address.region` (string or null): Region.
- `packages[].address.city` (string or null): Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.
- `packages[].address.street` (string or null): Street.
- `packages[].address.house` (string or null): House.
- `packages[].address.flat` (string or null): Flat.
- `packages[].address.zip` (string or null): Postal code.
- `packages[].passport_status` (string or null): Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review, `confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.
- `packages[].passport_link` (string or null): Link to the passport form for the recipient; `null` — no passport is needed now.
- `packages[].items` (array of object): Items of the package.
- `packages[].items[].id` (integer): Order item id (OZ).
- `packages[].items[].product_id` (integer or null): Product id.
- `packages[].items[].product_variation_id` (integer or null): Product variation id.
- `packages[].items[].name` (string): Product name at the moment of the order.
- `packages[].items[].status` (string): Item status: `not_bought`, `bought`, `in_stock`, `sent`, `delivered`, `canceled`.
- `packages[].items[].quantity` (integer): Quantity.
- `packages[].items[].price` (string): Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.
- `packages[].items[].image` (string or null): Product image saved with the order, absolute URL; `null` — the product had no image.

Errors:
- 400: `/api/problems/bad-request`
- 401: `/api/problems/unauthorized`
- 403: `/api/problems/customer-token-required`, `/api/problems/forbidden`
- 404: `/api/problems/not-found`
- 422: `/api/problems/validation-error`, `/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`
- 429: `/api/problems/too-many-requests`
